## J. MICHAEL FINLEY
##### Bart Millard
J. Michael Finley made his Broadway debut in **Les Miserables** in 2014, and is making his screen-acting debut in **I CAN ONLY IMAGINE**. His stage credits include playing Steve in **Hair** (at the Paramount Theatre), **Sweeney Todd** (at the Drury Lane Theatre) and Louie in **The Christmas Schooner** (in the Mercury Theater). After production wrapped on **I CAN ONLY IMAGINE**, J. Michael returned to Broadway.

## DENNIS QUAID
##### Arthur Millard
Dennis Quaid was born in Houston to Juanita Bonniedale, a real-estate agent, and William Rudy Quaid, an electrician. He grew up in the Houston suburb of Bellaire. He was raised a Baptist, and studied drama, Mandarin Chinese, and dance while a student at Bellaire High School. He continued his study at the University of Houston but dropped out before completing his degree. He moved to Los Angeles to pursue a film career where his brother, Randy Quaid, had already begun to build a successful career. However, Dennis initially had trouble finding film roles, but began to gain notice when he appeared in **Breaking Away** in 1979. He earned strong reviews for his role in **The Right Stuff**. Among his many other roles are the recent television series **American Crime Story** and the movie **A Dog’s Purpose**. Aside from acting, Quaid is also a musician and plays with his band, The Sharks. He also holds a flying license and is a five-handicap golfer.

## PRISCILLA SHIRER
##### Mrs. Fincher
Priscilla Shirer is a wife and mom first, but put a Bible in her hand and a message in her heart, and you’ll see why thousands meet God in powerful, personal ways at her conferences and through her books and Bible studies. She and her husband Jerry lead Going Beyond Ministries, thorough which they provide spiritual support and resources to the body of Christ. Between writing and studying, Priscilla can usually be found at home cleaning up after (and trying to satisfy the appetites of) her three rapidly growing boys. Priscilla played Elizabeth in the powerful movie **War Room**.

## MADELINE CARROLL
##### Shannon
Madeline Carroll began modeling when she was 3-years old after being “discovered” in a nail shop in Sherman Oaks, California. She has performed in 65 national commercials, and has guest-starred on several TV shows and series. Her favorite roles have been as Julie Baker in **Flipped**, and Molly in **Swing Vote**. She is active in giving to the foundation Zoe International, a non-profit Christian organization that rescues children from child prostitution. She also volunteers at The Dream Center and partners with her family in feeding the homeless every Tuesday night.

## TRACE ADKINS
##### Brickell
**I CAN ONLY IMAGINE** is Trace Adkins’ second film with the Erwin Brothers and Kevin Downes after starring as Bones in **Moms’ Night Out**. Trace's trademark baritone has powered countless hits to the top of the charts and turned albums into Platinum plaques, selling more than 10 million albums cumulatively. The Grammy-nominated member of the Grand Ole Opry is also a television personality, actor, and author. He’s also a spokesman for the Wounded Warrior Program and the American Red Cross, and he has performed seven USO Tours. He authored his autobiography, _A Personal Stand_, in 2007 and was a finalist in the 2008 version of NBC's **The Celebrity Apprentice**. Trace played a tough-as-nails biker in **The Lincoln Lawyer**, he developed and hosted GAC's **Great American Heroes** series to pay tribute to everyday Americans doing great things, and he has hosted the American Country Awards on FOX. Trace will soon be seen in the feature film **Hickok**.

## CLORIS LEACHMAN
##### Memaw
A true Hollywood icon, fan favorite Cloris Leachman has won an Oscar, a record-setting eight Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Daytime Emmy. In 2005, at age 82, she appeared on **Dancing with the Stars**. Born in Des Moines, Iowa, she moved to New York to pursue an acting career. She appeared in many television anthologies and series through the 1950s and 1960s with a handful of films, including **Kiss Me Deadly, The Rack, The Chapman Report**, and **Butch Cassidy And The Sundance Kid**. Though she won an Oscar for **The Last Picture Show** in 1971 and appeared in three Mel Brooks movies, her career remained mainly in television. Cloris won two Emmys for her work on **The Mary Tyler Moore Show**and the spin-off series **Phyllis**, for which she also won a Golden Globe Award. Her first Emmy was in 1973 for the television movie **A Brand New Life**. She also won two Emmys as a supporting player for **Malcolm in the Middle**. Cloris is 90-years young and not slowing down. She can be seen on the cable series **American Gods**.

After Bart's performance, he sees his father in the audience smiling and clapping. The audience gives an enthusiastic ovation, and he reunites with Shannon, who was also in attendance. The band releases the song as their first single, achieving success on both Christian and mainstream radio.

The film was announced in December 2016.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-oklahoma-9) Dennis Quaid joined the cast in January 2017.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-Deadline1517-10)Broadway actor J. Michael Finley, who sang all the songs in the movie, makes his film debut as Bart Millard.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-deadline81417-1) The same month, it was announced that the film was slated for release in the spring of 2018.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-Deadline1517-10) In August 2017, Lionsgate and Roadside Attractions signed on as distributors for the film for a nationwide release in the United States.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-deadline81417-1)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-11)
_I Can Only Imagine_ grossed $83.4 million in the United States and Canada and $1.8 million in other territories, for a worldwide total of $85.2 million, against a production budget of $7 million.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-TN-4) It is the highest-grossing independent film of 2018.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-12)
texts.5:
_I Can Only Imagine_ was released on March 16, 2018, alongside _Tomb Raider_ and _Love, Simon_, and was originally projected to gross $2–4 million from 1,620 theaters in its opening weekend.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-preview-13) However, after making $6.2 million on its first day (including $1.3 million from Thursday night previews), weekend estimates were increased to $14 million.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-opening-14) It ended up grossing $17.1 million, exceeding expectations and finishing third at the box office behind _Black Panther_ and _Tomb Raider_. 67% of the opening weekend audience was female while 80% was over the age of 35.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-opening2-15) It was the fourth best-ever opening for a faith-based film, following _The Passion of the Christ_ ($83.8 million), _Son of God_ ($25.6 million) and _Heaven Is for Real_ ($22.5 million).[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-16) In its second weekend the film was added to 624 additional theaters and dropped just 19% to $13.8 million, again finishing third.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-17) It was added to another 395 venues and finished fourth in its third weekend, making $10.4 million (including $3 million on Easter Sunday).[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-18)
The film has been translated and distributed in several countries,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-19) including China, according to co-director Jon Erwin:
texts.6:
> I find it very interesting that in the same year that China actually restricted ... Christianity, they paid for "I Can Only Imagine". ... They paid for the right to translate it and distribute it to their people. That's happened in over 100 countries around the world with our films.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-20)
On review aggregatorRotten Tomatoes, the film holds an approval rating of 69% based on 32 reviews, with an average rating of 5.8/10. The website's critical consensus reads, "_I Can Only Imagine_'s message will have the most impact among Christian audiences, but overall, its performances and storytelling represent a notable evolution in faith-based cinema."[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-21) However, on Metacritic, the film has a weighted average score of 30 out of 100, based on eight critics, indicating "generally unfavorable" reviews.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-22) Audiences polled by CinemaScore gave the film a rare average grade of "A+" on an A+ to F scale.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-opening-14)
texts.7:
_The Arizona Republic_'s James Ward gave the film 4 stars out of 5 and wrote, "Too often faith-based films—say anything with Kirk Cameron or the terrible _[God's Not Dead](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/God's\_Not\_Dead\_(film\_series) "God's Not Dead (film series)")_ series—tend to preach to the choir or hector their audience. The Erwins' films—_I Can Only Imagine_ definitely among them—are more inclusive, charitable of spirit and hopeful, all qualities that are always appreciated, be they rooted in Christian faith or otherwise."[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-23) David Ehrlich of IndieWire gave the film a "C−" saying: "There's a reason why all of these movies are so amateurishly made; why they all end with links to religious websites; why they all look like they were shot on an iPhone by a Walmart-brand Janusz Kaminski who lit each interior like the white light of heaven was streaming through every window... Art can be affirmation, but affirmation cannot be art."[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-24)
Faith-based reviewers mostly gave the movie positive reviews. Megan Basham of _World_ magazine called Quaid "the real workhorse" and added that he "bears the heavy load of convincingly giving us both a monster and a repentant dad longing to connect with his son. Quaid impresses on both counts."[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-25) Michael Foust of the _Southern Baptist Texan_ gave the film 5 out of 5 stars and wrote, "The screenplay is gripping, the soundtrack is perfect, and the performances by Quaid and Finley had me squirming, laughing and crying."[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-26)
texts.8: The film was released on iTunes and Google Play on June 5, 2018, and on DVD and Blu-ray on June 12, 2018.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-27)[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-28)_I Can Only Imagine_ was the no. 1 film in DVD sales and rentals for the weeks ending June 17 and June 24, 2018.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-30) As of February 2020, _I Can Only Imagine_ has earned $24 million in home media sales.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-TN-4)

# What You Didn’t Know About ‘I Can Only Imagine’s’ Lead Actor, J.Michael Finley
## Casting J.Michael Finley in the Role of Bart Millard
Choosing who to play Bart took time, but when the crew found J. Michael Finley, they knew it was meant to be.
“We found [Finely] on Broadway”, says Downes. “He was playing the role of John Valjean in Les Miserables. We thought, ‘is this kid for real?’
“So we put him through an audition process and what we found out was that he’s a Baptist preachers kid, from Middle America, who grew up going to Mercy Me concerts. We thought, ‘You’re too good to be true’.”
With the perfect cast, including Dennis Quaid as Bart’s Dad, the producers felt they had a responsibility to honour the original intention of the song, and make sure its heart was well told in the movie.
> “He’s a Baptist preachers kid, from middle-America, who grew up going to Mercy Me concerts. We thought, ‘You’re too good to be true’.”
“Many people say that when they first heard the song they had this tremendous rush of hope, and this picture of what Heaven could be like. So we do the same thing with the movie; the movie paints this picture of a tremendous rush of hope at the end of the film and some people have said it’s one of the most brilliant endings they’ve ever seen—which is certainly very high remarks, but we’re very happy with it.”
Asked how he thinks anyone could forgive someone who’d wronged them as much as Bart’s Dad did him, Downes says, “I don’t know. For what Bart went through to all of a sudden just say, ‘You know what Dad, I completely forgive you’, what Bart would say is, ‘it was only God, and God deserves all the credit because the work that Jesus Christ did on the cross was sufficient’. That it was the Holy Spirit in him that allowed him to do that.”
_I Can Only Imagine_ is in cinemas March 15.

## J. MICHAEL FINLEY
##### Bart Millard
J. Michael Finley made his Broadway debut in **Les Miserables** in 2014, and is making his screen-acting debut in **I CAN ONLY IMAGINE**. His stage credits include playing Steve in **Hair** (at the Paramount Theatre), **Sweeney Todd** (at the Drury Lane Theatre) and Louie in **The Christmas Schooner** (in the Mercury Theater). After production wrapped on **I CAN ONLY IMAGINE**, J. Michael returned to Broadway.
texts.1:
## DENNIS QUAID
##### Arthur Millard
Dennis Quaid was born in Houston to Juanita Bonniedale, a real-estate agent, and William Rudy Quaid, an electrician. He grew up in the Houston suburb of Bellaire. He was raised a Baptist, and studied drama, Mandarin Chinese, and dance while a student at Bellaire High School. He continued his study at the University of Houston but dropped out before completing his degree. He moved to Los Angeles to pursue a film career where his brother, Randy Quaid, had already begun to build a successful career. However, Dennis initially had trouble finding film roles, but began to gain notice when he appeared in **Breaking Away** in 1979. He earned strong reviews for his role in **The Right Stuff**. Among his many other roles are the recent television series **American Crime Story** and the movie **A Dog’s Purpose**. Aside from acting, Quaid is also a musician and plays with his band, The Sharks. He also holds a flying license and is a five-handicap golfer.

## PRISCILLA SHIRER
##### Mrs. Fincher
Priscilla Shirer is a wife and mom first, but put a Bible in her hand and a message in her heart, and you’ll see why thousands meet God in powerful, personal ways at her conferences and through her books and Bible studies. She and her husband Jerry lead Going Beyond Ministries, thorough which they provide spiritual support and resources to the body of Christ. Between writing and studying, Priscilla can usually be found at home cleaning up after (and trying to satisfy the appetites of) her three rapidly growing boys. Priscilla played Elizabeth in the powerful movie **War Room**.

## MADELINE CARROLL
##### Shannon
Madeline Carroll began modeling when she was 3-years old after being “discovered” in a nail shop in Sherman Oaks, California. She has performed in 65 national commercials, and has guest-starred on several TV shows and series. Her favorite roles have been as Julie Baker in **Flipped**, and Molly in **Swing Vote**. She is active in giving to the foundation Zoe International, a non-profit Christian organization that rescues children from child prostitution. She also volunteers at The Dream Center and partners with her family in feeding the homeless every Tuesday night.

## TRACE ADKINS
##### Brickell
**I CAN ONLY IMAGINE** is Trace Adkins’ second film with the Erwin Brothers and Kevin Downes after starring as Bones in **Moms’ Night Out**. Trace's trademark baritone has powered countless hits to the top of the charts and turned albums into Platinum plaques, selling more than 10 million albums cumulatively. The Grammy-nominated member of the Grand Ole Opry is also a television personality, actor, and author. He’s also a spokesman for the Wounded Warrior Program and the American Red Cross, and he has performed seven USO Tours. He authored his autobiography, _A Personal Stand_, in 2007 and was a finalist in the 2008 version of NBC's **The Celebrity Apprentice**. Trace played a tough-as-nails biker in **The Lincoln Lawyer**, he developed and hosted GAC's **Great American Heroes** series to pay tribute to everyday Americans doing great things, and he has hosted the American Country Awards on FOX. Trace will soon be seen in the feature film **Hickok**.

## CLORIS LEACHMAN
##### Memaw
A true Hollywood icon, fan favorite Cloris Leachman has won an Oscar, a record-setting eight Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Daytime Emmy. In 2005, at age 82, she appeared on **Dancing with the Stars**. Born in Des Moines, Iowa, she moved to New York to pursue an acting career. She appeared in many television anthologies and series through the 1950s and 1960s with a handful of films, including **Kiss Me Deadly, The Rack, The Chapman Report**, and **Butch Cassidy And The Sundance Kid**. Though she won an Oscar for **The Last Picture Show** in 1971 and appeared in three Mel Brooks movies, her career remained mainly in television. Cloris won two Emmys for her work on **The Mary Tyler Moore Show**and the spin-off series **Phyllis**, for which she also won a Golden Globe Award. Her first Emmy was in 1973 for the television movie **A Brand New Life**. She also won two Emmys as a supporting player for **Malcolm in the Middle**. Cloris is 90-years young and not slowing down. She can be seen on the cable series **American Gods**.

*   Cole Marcus as Robbie Shaffer, the percussionist of MercyMe

The film was announced in December 2016.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-oklahoma-9) Dennis Quaid joined the cast in January 2017.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-Deadline1517-10)Broadway actor J. Michael Finley, who sang all the songs in the movie, makes his film debut as Bart Millard.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-deadline81417-1) The same month, it was announced that the film was slated for release in the spring of 2018.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-Deadline1517-10) In August 2017, Lionsgate and Roadside Attractions signed on as distributors for the film for a nationwide release in the United States.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-deadline81417-1)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-11)
_I Can Only Imagine_ grossed $83.4 million in the United States and Canada and $1.8 million in other territories, for a worldwide total of $85.2 million, against a production budget of $7 million.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-TN-4) It is the highest-grossing independent film of 2018.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-12)

_I Can Only Imagine_ was released on March 16, 2018, alongside _Tomb Raider_ and _Love, Simon_, and was originally projected to gross $2–4 million from 1,620 theaters in its opening weekend.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-preview-13) However, after making $6.2 million on its first day (including $1.3 million from Thursday night previews), weekend estimates were increased to $14 million.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-opening-14) It ended up grossing $17.1 million, exceeding expectations and finishing third at the box office behind _Black Panther_ and _Tomb Raider_. 67% of the opening weekend audience was female while 80% was over the age of 35.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-opening2-15) It was the fourth best-ever opening for a faith-based film, following _The Passion of the Christ_ ($83.8 million), _Son of God_ ($25.6 million) and _Heaven Is for Real_ ($22.5 million).[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-16) In its second weekend the film was added to 624 additional theaters and dropped just 19% to $13.8 million, again finishing third.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-17) It was added to another 395 venues and finished fourth in its third weekend, making $10.4 million (including $3 million on Easter Sunday).[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-18)
The film has been translated and distributed in several countries,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-19) including China, according to co-director Jon Erwin:

> I find it very interesting that in the same year that China actually restricted ... Christianity, they paid for "I Can Only Imagine". ... They paid for the right to translate it and distribute it to their people. That's happened in over 100 countries around the world with our films.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-20)
On review aggregatorRotten Tomatoes, the film holds an approval rating of 69% based on 32 reviews, with an average rating of 5.8/10. The website's critical consensus reads, "_I Can Only Imagine_'s message will have the most impact among Christian audiences, but overall, its performances and storytelling represent a notable evolution in faith-based cinema."[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-21) However, on Metacritic, the film has a weighted average score of 30 out of 100, based on eight critics, indicating "generally unfavorable" reviews.[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-22) Audiences polled by CinemaScore gave the film a rare average grade of "A+" on an A+ to F scale.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-opening-14)

_The Arizona Republic_'s James Ward gave the film 4 stars out of 5 and wrote, "Too often faith-based films—say anything with Kirk Cameron or the terrible _[God's Not Dead](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/God's\_Not\_Dead\_(film\_series) "God's Not Dead (film series)")_ series—tend to preach to the choir or hector their audience. The Erwins' films—_I Can Only Imagine_ definitely among them—are more inclusive, charitable of spirit and hopeful, all qualities that are always appreciated, be they rooted in Christian faith or otherwise."[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-23) David Ehrlich of IndieWire gave the film a "C−" saying: "There's a reason why all of these movies are so amateurishly made; why they all end with links to religious websites; why they all look like they were shot on an iPhone by a Walmart-brand Janusz Kaminski who lit each interior like the white light of heaven was streaming through every window... Art can be affirmation, but affirmation cannot be art."[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-24)
Faith-based reviewers mostly gave the movie positive reviews. Megan Basham of _World_ magazine called Quaid "the real workhorse" and added that he "bears the heavy load of convincingly giving us both a monster and a repentant dad longing to connect with his son. Quaid impresses on both counts."[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-25) Michael Foust of the _Southern Baptist Texan_ gave the film 5 out of 5 stars and wrote, "The screenplay is gripping, the soundtrack is perfect, and the performances by Quaid and Finley had me squirming, laughing and crying."[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-26)

The film was released on iTunes and Google Play on June 5, 2018, and on DVD and Blu-ray on June 12, 2018.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-27)[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-28)_I Can Only Imagine_ was the no. 1 film in DVD sales and rentals for the weeks ending June 17 and June 24, 2018.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-30) As of February 2020, _I Can Only Imagine_ has earned $24 million in home media sales.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-TN-4)

# What You Didn’t Know About ‘I Can Only Imagine’s’ Lead Actor, J.Michael Finley
## Casting J.Michael Finley in the Role of Bart Millard
Choosing who to play Bart took time, but when the crew found J. Michael Finley, they knew it was meant to be.
“We found [Finely] on Broadway”, says Downes. “He was playing the role of John Valjean in Les Miserables. We thought, ‘is this kid for real?’
“So we put him through an audition process and what we found out was that he’s a Baptist preachers kid, from Middle America, who grew up going to Mercy Me concerts. We thought, ‘You’re too good to be true’.”
With the perfect cast, including Dennis Quaid as Bart’s Dad, the producers felt they had a responsibility to honour the original intention of the song, and make sure its heart was well told in the movie.
> “He’s a Baptist preachers kid, from middle-America, who grew up going to Mercy Me concerts. We thought, ‘You’re too good to be true’.”
“Many people say that when they first heard the song they had this tremendous rush of hope, and this picture of what Heaven could be like. So we do the same thing with the movie; the movie paints this picture of a tremendous rush of hope at the end of the film and some people have said it’s one of the most brilliant endings they’ve ever seen—which is certainly very high remarks, but we’re very happy with it.”
Asked how he thinks anyone could forgive someone who’d wronged them as much as Bart’s Dad did him, Downes says, “I don’t know. For what Bart went through to all of a sudden just say, ‘You know what Dad, I completely forgive you’, what Bart would say is, ‘it was only God, and God deserves all the credit because the work that Jesus Christ did on the cross was sufficient’. That it was the Holy Spirit in him that allowed him to do that.”
_I Can Only Imagine_ is in cinemas March 15.

## J. MICHAEL FINLEY
##### Bart Millard
J. Michael Finley made his Broadway debut in **Les Miserables** in 2014, and is making his screen-acting debut in **I CAN ONLY IMAGINE**. His stage credits include playing Steve in **Hair** (at the Paramount Theatre), **Sweeney Todd** (at the Drury Lane Theatre) and Louie in **The Christmas Schooner** (in the Mercury Theater). After production wrapped on **I CAN ONLY IMAGINE**, J. Michael returned to Broadway.

## DENNIS QUAID
##### Arthur Millard
Dennis Quaid was born in Houston to Juanita Bonniedale, a real-estate agent, and William Rudy Quaid, an electrician. He grew up in the Houston suburb of Bellaire. He was raised a Baptist, and studied drama, Mandarin Chinese, and dance while a student at Bellaire High School. He continued his study at the University of Houston but dropped out before completing his degree. He moved to Los Angeles to pursue a film career where his brother, Randy Quaid, had already begun to build a successful career. However, Dennis initially had trouble finding film roles, but began to gain notice when he appeared in **Breaking Away** in 1979. He earned strong reviews for his role in **The Right Stuff**. Among his many other roles are the recent television series **American Crime Story** and the movie **A Dog’s Purpose**. Aside from acting, Quaid is also a musician and plays with his band, The Sharks. He also holds a flying license and is a five-handicap golfer.

## PRISCILLA SHIRER
##### Mrs. Fincher
Priscilla Shirer is a wife and mom first, but put a Bible in her hand and a message in her heart, and you’ll see why thousands meet God in powerful, personal ways at her conferences and through her books and Bible studies. She and her husband Jerry lead Going Beyond Ministries, thorough which they provide spiritual support and resources to the body of Christ. Between writing and studying, Priscilla can usually be found at home cleaning up after (and trying to satisfy the appetites of) her three rapidly growing boys. Priscilla played Elizabeth in the powerful movie **War Room**.

## MADELINE CARROLL
##### Shannon
Madeline Carroll began modeling when she was 3-years old after being “discovered” in a nail shop in Sherman Oaks, California. She has performed in 65 national commercials, and has guest-starred on several TV shows and series. Her favorite roles have been as Julie Baker in **Flipped**, and Molly in **Swing Vote**. She is active in giving to the foundation Zoe International, a non-profit Christian organization that rescues children from child prostitution. She also volunteers at The Dream Center and partners with her family in feeding the homeless every Tuesday night.

## TRACE ADKINS
##### Brickell
**I CAN ONLY IMAGINE** is Trace Adkins’ second film with the Erwin Brothers and Kevin Downes after starring as Bones in **Moms’ Night Out**. Trace's trademark baritone has powered countless hits to the top of the charts and turned albums into Platinum plaques, selling more than 10 million albums cumulatively. The Grammy-nominated member of the Grand Ole Opry is also a television personality, actor, and author. He’s also a spokesman for the Wounded Warrior Program and the American Red Cross, and he has performed seven USO Tours. He authored his autobiography, _A Personal Stand_, in 2007 and was a finalist in the 2008 version of NBC's **The Celebrity Apprentice**. Trace played a tough-as-nails biker in **The Lincoln Lawyer**, he developed and hosted GAC's **Great American Heroes** series to pay tribute to everyday Americans doing great things, and he has hosted the American Country Awards on FOX. Trace will soon be seen in the feature film **Hickok**.

## CLORIS LEACHMAN
##### Memaw
A true Hollywood icon, fan favorite Cloris Leachman has won an Oscar, a record-setting eight Primetime Emmy Awards, and a Daytime Emmy. In 2005, at age 82, she appeared on **Dancing with the Stars**. Born in Des Moines, Iowa, she moved to New York to pursue an acting career. She appeared in many television anthologies and series through the 1950s and 1960s with a handful of films, including **Kiss Me Deadly, The Rack, The Chapman Report**, and **Butch Cassidy And The Sundance Kid**. Though she won an Oscar for **The Last Picture Show** in 1971 and appeared in three Mel Brooks movies, her career remained mainly in television. Cloris won two Emmys for her work on **The Mary Tyler Moore Show**and the spin-off series **Phyllis**, for which she also won a Golden Globe Award. Her first Emmy was in 1973 for the television movie **A Brand New Life**. She also won two Emmys as a supporting player for **Malcolm in the Middle**. Cloris is 90-years young and not slowing down. She can be seen on the cable series **American Gods**.

[Dennis Quaid](https://people.com/tag/dennis-quaid/) experienced "[love at first sight](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-says-it-was-love-at-first-sight-with-new-wife-laura-savoie/)" with his wife, Laura Savoie.

The two met at a business event in 2019 and [got married](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-and-laura-savoie-are-married/) a year later in June 2020.

Savoie is _The Parent Trap_ star's fourth wife. He was previously married to P.J. Soles from 1978 to 1983, [Meg Ryan](https://people.com/tag/meg-ryan/) from 1991 to 2001 and [Kimberly Buffington](https://people.com/celebrity/dennis-quaid-and-kimberly-buffington-inside-their-turbulent-marriage/) from 2004 to 2018. He shares son [Jack](https://people.com/movies/jack-quaid-says-parents-dennis-quaid-and-meg-ryan-dont-give-acting-advice/) with Ryan and twins [Thomas and Zoe](https://people.com/parents/dennis-kimberly-quaid-welcome-a-boy-girl/) with Buffington.

In December 2021, Quaid and Savoie founded the production company Bonniedale Films.

“Laura's the [love of my life](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-talks-about-love-of-my-life-laura-savoie-7565513),”Quaid told PEOPLE in July 2023. “She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before. It's a joy of life that we share together.”

So, who is the actor's fourth wife? Here is everything to know about Laura Savoie, Dennis Quaid's wife.

## **She graduated from Pepperdine University**

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie in 2025.
Kevin Mazur/Getty

Originally from St. Louis, Savoie obtained her undergraduate degree in accounting from Pepperdine University. According to her [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/laurasavoie/), she not only completed her bachelor's degree in three years, but she was also the valedictorian of her graduating class.

Savoie also earned a master's degree in accounting, financial reporting and assurance services from the University of Notre Dame.

When she and Quaid [met and began dating](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-dating-university-texas-student/), she was working toward her PhD at the University of Texas at Austin.

## **She is a certified public accountant and holds a real estate license**

Terry Wyatt/WireImage

Savoie became a certified public accountant in the state of California in 2015, per her [LinkedIn bio](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-dating-university-texas-student/). A year later, she obtained her real estate license.

From 2015 to 2017, Savoie was employed at the accounting firm Ernst & Young in Los Angeles, where she worked with clients in the "real estate, biopharmaceutical, retail consumer products, media and entertainment" industries as part of the company's assurance team.

## **She's a registered yoga instructor**

In addition to her various business endeavors, Savoie is also a registered yoga instructor, per her LinkedIn.

Quaid also enjoys practicing yoga. In 2018, he told _[Men's Health](https://www.menshealth.com/entertainment/a18782822/dennis-quaid-fitness-workout-i-can-only-imagine/)_ that he changed up his exercise routine as he got older.

"I turned to cycling, which I'm currently doing. That and yoga. Along with that, you got to still get into the gym and lift. Do the sit-ups," he said.

## **She has done a lot of volunteer work**

Marco Garcia/Getty

Savoie has spent a good deal of her time giving back to various causes. Her [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/laurasavoie/) lists several volunteer organizations that she has been a part of over the years, including Baja Build, Standing on Stone Malibu Community Outreach, Fiji Kinde Project and Oasis of Hollywood.

## **She and Quaid met in 2019**

The couple met in 2019 at a business event after being introduced by a mutual friend. Quaid later told PEOPLE it was "[love at first sight](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-says-it-was-love-at-first-sight-with-new-wife-laura-savoie/)."

"I just love who she is as a person. Her character, her intelligence, of course, her beauty. And her point of view of the world," he added.

## **She loves to travel with Quaid**

Flightrisk / BACKGRID

Over the past couple of years, Savoie and Quaid have done plenty of traveling together. Shortly after PEOPLE confirmed the two were dating, they were [spotted in Lake Como, Italy](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-vacations-with-girlfriend-laura-savoie-bikini-italy/). A couple of months later, they were seen [paddleboarding on a beach in Waikiki](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-hawaii-beach-girlfriend-laura-savoie/), Hawaii.

Quaid and Savoie have grown fond of Hawaii and have traveled to the state quite a few times over the course of their relationship. In fact, Quaid [popped the question](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-engaged-laura-savoie/) during a trip to Oahu.

"I had the ring in my pocket … It has been kind of a month-and-a-half plan … I wanted it to be private," Quaid told _Extra_ in October 2019. "She was actually taking a selfie of us, and I put the ring in front and said, 'Will you marry me?' — and then she fell down," he added.

## **She and Quaid got married in 2020**

Dennis Quaid Laura Savoie.Elizabeth Messina

Quaid and Savoie had originally planned to get married in Hawaii in April 2020 with a reception to be held at a later date in Nashville, but the couple were [forced to postpone their plans](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-postpones-wedding-amid-coronavirus-fears/) due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

The pair decided they didn't want to wait to exchange vows, so they [eloped in Santa Barbara](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-and-laura-savoie-are-married/) at a seaside resort on June 2, 2020, with their pastor as the only witness present. The bride wore a Chosen By One Day gown, while the groom chose a light gray Hugo Boss suit.

"It was beautiful," Quaid told PEOPLE of the intimate ceremony.

## **She and Quaid have a shared faith**

Daniele Venturelli/Getty

Shortly after their wedding, the couple opened up about their shared faith with PEOPLE, explaining that it is their "[greatest source of strength](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-wife-says-their-shared-faith-greatest-strength/)." Quaid and Savoie also revealed that it helped get them through the COVID-19 pandemic.

"With the quarantine, it hasn't been easy," Savoie said. "And when you just pray together and say that this is where I'm having a hard time, help us be the people we're supposed to be towards each other. It changes everything."

She continued, "It brings you back to being loving and kind towards each other and working through those things that inevitably come up. And it's just the greatest source of strength in our relationship to have, to share that."

In July 2023, Quaid told PEOPLE that his and Savoie's faith is key to the [success of their marriage](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-talks-about-love-of-my-life-laura-savoie-7565513). “God is in the relationship,” he explained. “I've never had a relationship like that before."

## **She and Quaid "don't even notice" their age gap**

Quaid is 39 years older than Savoie,but that doesn't phase the couple. During an interview on the _Today_ show, Quaid said: "There's 30-something years between us, and [we just don't even notice it](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-on-39-year-age-gap-between-him-and-wife-you-have-no-control-over-who-you-love/). I've never related to someone in my life better than we do."

He continued, "We have such a great relationship and you know, love finds a way, wherever it is. You never know when love is coming, who it's gonna be, and you have no control over it. We just couldn't be happier."

The actor had previously told PEOPLE that their age difference just "[doesn't come up](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-says-it-was-love-at-first-sight-with-new-wife-laura-savoie/)." He said, "There's just something timeless about us. We're partners in our relationship and in life. It's love. And love just has a way of surprising you."

## She and Quaid launched a production company together

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie in 2024.
Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic

In December 2021, Quaid and Savoie teamed up to launch the production company Bonniedale Films, along with co-founder Ben Howard, per [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2021/12/dennis-quaid-charley-pride-movie-craig-brewer-directs-bonniedale-laura-quaid-ben-howard-1234887946/). Their first film under the company will be _American Pride_, an upcoming biopic of country star [Charley Pride](https://people.com/country/cma-awards-2020-charley-pride-lifetime-achievement-award/).

Howard, who produced the Quaid-starring film _Blue Miracle_, said in a statement at the time, "I'm excited to work with Dennis and Laura in making the world a better place through the films, shows and content we develop and produce."

The production company is based in Nashville, where the couple live.

## She is supportive of Quaid's career

Scott Kirkland/Shutterstock

In addition to being one of Hollywood's most iconic actors, Quaid is also the lead singer and guitarist of his band Dennis Quaid and The Sharks.

Savoie has supported her husband at concerts, award shows and movie premieres over the years, including the[2022 CMT Awards](https://people.com/movies/cmt-awards-2022-dennis-quaid-wife-laura-savoie-red-carpet-photos/)and a Los Angeles screening of Quaid's latest film [_The Long Game_](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-makes-red-carpet-appearance-with-wife-laura-savoie-days-after-70th-birthday-8629959) in April 2024.

## She and Quaid are true crime fans

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie in 2024.
Mindy Small/FilmMagi

While speaking to PEOPLE in March 2025, Quaid revealed that he and Savoie often "[fall asleep to _Dateline_](https://people.com/happy-face-star-dennis-quaid-and-wife-laura-savoie-fall-asleep-to-dateline-exclusive-11700190)." He said they particularly enjoy the "murder stories."

However, Savoie was slightly creeped out by her husband's latest role as the Happy Face Killer[Keith Jesperson](https://people.com/where-is-keith-hunter-jesperson-now-happy-face-killer-11691801)in the Paramount+ series[_Happy Face_](https://people.com/see-dennis-quaid-as-a-murderous-serial-killer-in-first-happy-face-trailer-8781346).

"That'd be creepy for me too, but she knows me," he told [_Fox News_](https://www.foxnews.com/video/6370249618112) before the show premiered on March 20.

Dennis Quaid has been one of Hollywood's rugged leading men for decades with a string of famous romances to his name, including four marriages. One of [Dennis' four marriages has raised red flags for the somewhat alarming age gap](https://www.thelist.com/2099806/glaring-red-flags-dennis-quaid-age-gap-marriage/), with nearly 40 years between the actor and his fourth wife, Laura Savoie. However, the age gap hasn't deterred their apparent passion. In 2023, Quaid told [People](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-talks-about-love-of-my-life-laura-savoie-7565513), "Laura's the love of my life. She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before. It's a joy of life that we share together."

Dennis' cowboy-esque charisma and striking grin made him a catch for the women of Hollywood, of whom Dennis has had his share. He married his first wife, fellow actor P.J. Soles, in 1978 after working together in the film "Our Winning Season." They split in 1983, and then came the iconic[relationship between Dennis and Meg Ryan in the '90s](https://www.thelist.com/2177441/meg-ryan-dennis-quaid-pics-make-us-miss-the-90s/),whom he married in 1991. They share a son, actor Jack Quaid, but they divorced in 2001 after rumored infidelity on both parts.

Dennis ditched Hollywood dating after a few years and entered his third marriage to Kimberly Buffington, a real estate agent from Texas. They tied the knot in 2004 and later welcomed twins Thomas and Zoe via a surrogate. Things reportedly got rocky for the couple in 2012 and they ultimately divorced in 2016 after 12 years together. Similar to Buffington, Savoie isn't a public figure, even after her marriage to Dennis put her in the spotlight. Savoie began her life and career as an academic before a chance meeting led her to marry the Hollywood icon. Read on for everything we know about Dennis' fourth wife.

Read more: [Kenny Rogers' Ex-Wife Opens Up About Dolly Parton](https://www.thelist.com/198602/kenny-rogers-ex-wife-opens-up-about-dolly-parton/?zsource=yahoo)

## Laura Savoie holds two master's degrees and a real estate license

![Image 1: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie smiling together at an event in 2024](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/a7ffa84985be593a8daf37676a993577b594a63b5f5acc8dffb5064e751eef41/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w780_h438%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_list_205%2Fb89589231f72ddc8d21088ce93acd404)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie smiling together at an event in 2024 - Amy Sussman/Getty Images

Laura Savoie does not appear to have held any Hollywood aspirations in her career, based on the information listed in her public [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/laurasavoie/) profile. According to the site, Savoie graduated from Pepperdine University and holds two master's degrees from the Texas McCombs School of Business and the University of Notre Dame, the latter of which she graduated with honors. There are unconfirmed reports that Savoie dated actor Jeremy Piven while she attended Pepperdine, but neither party has ever confirmed or spoken about the rumors.

Savoie worked as a research and teaching assistant at both her graduate schools, and she followed up with a job in the assurance department at Ernst & Young. She holds other certifications as well, including a real estate license and yoga teacher registration. As of 2025, her current job is listed as partner and founder at Bonniedale Films, a production company she launched with Quaid.According to a 2021 report from [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2021/12/dennis-quaid-charley-pride-movie-craig-brewer-directs-bonniedale-laura-quaid-ben-howard-1234887946/),Savoie bought the rights to the Aimee Mayo memoir "Talking to the Sky," which documents the singer's career as a songwriter. Bonniedale Films took on the memoir as a potential film project.

## Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie met in 2019 and married in 2020

![Image 2: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie smiling at an event in Italy in 2025](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/4153a9945e30415f2a10e14de60a78f2f811c4fb4b513168b5d3034b023cab40/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w780_h438%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_list_205%2F386b89940fd0e5028b7c3e95d16ccbad)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie smiling at an event in Italy in 2025 - Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images

It seems like Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie had a whirlwind romance after meeting in 2019. "It was love at first sight," he told [People](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-says-it-was-love-at-first-sight-with-new-wife-laura-savoie/). The pair met at a business event in 2019 and dated for about five months before getting engaged in October of that year."I just love who she is as a person," said Quaid. "Her character, her intelligence, of course, her beauty. And her point of view of the world."

The couple had plans for a wedding in Hawaii with a second reception in Nashville that were put on hold due to the COVID-19 pandemic, so they opted to elope in Santa Barbara on June 2, 2020. Quaid told the outlet, "And we're really glad we did. It was about us. It was beautiful." Savoie also spoke with [People](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-and-laura-savoie-are-married/), saying she has "never met someone who is so in love with life. It's like nothing can bring him down. Just getting to do life with someone who lives that way is inspiring for me. It changes my perspective and it brings so much joy to every day."

## Laura Savoie and Dennis Quaid share a strong Christian faith

![Image 3: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie posing at CinemaCon in 2024](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/743e814b639ad3707b3d10827ffd95846c7e57fa6b7e8db32c09d6102fc6e2a1/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w780_h438%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_list_205%2Fa1d92cd450a9f779b0c1a4004900690c)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie posing at CinemaCon in 2024 - Mindy Small/Getty Images

Over the course of his Hollywood career, Dennis Quaid has become more open about the importance of his Christian faith, which is one of the things he and fourth wife Laura Savoie share. Savoie told [People](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-wife-says-their-shared-faith-greatest-strength/) in 2020, shortly after she and Quaid married, that faith is the "greatest source of strength in our relationship." Quaid echoed this statement, adding, "We're both Christians, and right from the start God has always had a hand in the relationship."

In 2025, five years into the marriage, Quaid gushed again about Savoie and how faith played a role in the relationship. "It's the closest relationship I've ever had with anybody. Every day is paradise. What can I tell you? I don't know why God had waited so long to bring her, for her to come along, but [I'm] really glad he brought her into my life, or I walked into hers," he told [Fox News Digital](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/dennis-quaid-says-every-day-paradise-wife-39-years-his-junior).

## Laura Savoie is significantly younger than Dennis Quaid

![Image 4: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie sitting together at an event in 2023](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/5bb46c84235f4260c8e4d66db0cd2612c036e59d2b830c120a606198a31e33a5/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w780_h438%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_list_205%2Fbbbd5c1f067c54a111e93b77716a160f)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie sitting together at an event in 2023 - Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images

One of the much-discussed elements of Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie's relationship is their rather significant age gap, one of[the biggest age differences between celebrity couples](https://www.thelist.com/485673/celebrity-couples-with-the-biggest-age-differences/)in Hollywood.Quaid is 39 years older than Savoie, but he has said multiple times he never intended to find someone so much younger than him."I didn't go out looking for an age gap or someone really younger than me,"he told [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2019/nov/25/dennis-quaid-i-didnt-go-looking-for-someone-younger-on-his-new-love-and-new-roles)in 2019, shortly into the relationship. "I met her at a business event and then the relationship developed. You have no control over who you fall in love with. I don't fall in love easy."

The contentious topic has been brought up several times, but Quaid brushes it off with ease. "I haven't spoken out about the age difference of my wife. Other people have. But ... I really don't think about it," he told [Fox News Digital](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/dennis-quaid-credits-god-happy-marriage-light-my-life)in 2024. "She's got so much going on that, you know, I just don't notice it. She's just, she's the light of my life." Similarly,Dennis insisted the age gap between himself and Savoie is something they both "just never noticed," per an interview with [People](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-talks-about-love-of-my-life-laura-savoie-7565513).

## Dennis Quaid has said his marriage to Laura Savoie will be his 'final' one

![Image 5: Dennis Quiad and Laura Savoie posing together at an event in 2023](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/3ab0c6b889b7ac38d86ad6c5cf3b68d7bad880ce78782ceb1e8190c6d3a2f6ed/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w780_h438%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_list_205%2F7a992db8c080b6d41b3958b1ced950dc)

Dennis Quiad and Laura Savoie posing together at an event in 2023 - Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images

Dennis Quaid has been married three times prior to his marriage to Laura Savoie, not an atypical number by Hollywood standards. But Quaid has declared that this marriage, his fourth, to Laura Savoie is going to be the one to stick. During a 2019 appearance on "[The View,](https://x.com/TheView/status/1201933707298263040)"Quaid was teased about being married before by Joy Behar, to which he replied, "[This time is the] fourth and final — this is it." He added more praise, saying, "She's really fantastic. She has a double master's right now in economics and business. She's just a soulful, wonderful, beautiful person."

He made a similar comment in his 2019 interview with [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2019/nov/25/dennis-quaid-i-didnt-go-looking-for-someone-younger-on-his-new-love-and-new-roles), saying, "I've been married three times and this is the final one, I know it is. I feel like I have a real partner in life." There are multiple other interviews with Quaid over their six-year relationship where he heaps praise on Savoie, insisting he has never felt this way about anyone before."She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before,"he told [People](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-talks-about-love-of-my-life-laura-savoie-7565513) in 2023.

## Laura Savoie's social media is private

![Image 6: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie posing together in 2022](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/f203d20a5ac118e77eb38bf7c53f7898aa07bde0f584aef65d2a8de778c8bde3/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w780_h438%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_list_205%2F674e087436994ff108fdbe326607c2c4)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie posing together in 2022 - Catherine Powell/Getty Images

Before her relationship with Dennis Quaid, Laura Savoie was not a public figure, though her marriage to a Hollywood legend certainly ushered her into the spotlight. While Savoie's Instagram account is set to private,[Us Weekly](https://www.usmagazine.com/celebrity-news/news/dennis-quaid-dating-laura-savoie-after-split-from-santa-auzina/) claimed that she regularly gushed about the actor on her Instagram page in the early stages of their relationship. That included a photo of the duo hugging with a caption that read, "Never been happier." Quaid also has an [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/dennisquaid/?hl=en) page, but it leans almost exclusively toward business and promotion posts.

Savoie has also given very few interviews since her marriage to Quaid. She spoke out a few times around the time they tied the knot in 2020. "We both had to go through things to be who we are now and who we are now was ready for each other," she told[People](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-says-it-was-love-at-first-sight-with-new-wife-laura-savoie/)at the time, adding how she appreciated the "wisdom" he had. But since then, she has largely kept to herself. Meanwhile, Quaid often brings up his love for her in interviews, as evidenced by his quotes above.

## Laura Savoie became a stepmom to three kids when she married Dennis Quaid

![Image 7: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie posing together at the 2022 CMT Music Awards](https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/cf2133b0e8c2b3771e765261f1d105ad46c741f0e2ede4816557a798ff391c64/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w780_h438%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fthe_list_205%2F47a7bb72e50938b5a5ed9c30aabd6760)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie posing together at the 2022 CMT Music Awards - Mike Coppola/Getty Images

Laura Savoie had no children of her own prior to meeting Dennis Quaid, and in all the interviews and discussions about their relationship, it seems they do not appear to have plans to add to the family. Dennis is already a father to three children. He shares eldest son, Jack Quaid, with his second ex-wife, Meg Ryan. Despite their rocky separation, [Dennis and Ryan maintain a family bond that Jack has never given up on](https://www.thelist.com/2166716/meg-ryan-dennis-quaid-son-jack-reportedly-never-gave-up-on-mending-bond-finally-paid-off/). Dennis also shares twins with his third ex-wife, Kimberly Buffington. In 2026, Dennis filed to end his $13,750 monthly child support payments to Buffington for the twins, Thomas and Zoe, who were 18 years old at the time and high school graduates. According to documents obtained by [People](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-files-to-stop-paying-nearly-14k-in-monthly-child-support-to-ex-wife-11985920), the divorce agreement stated the payments would end when the kids finished 12th grade. The agreement also noted he was required to pay Buffington an additional sum each year if he makes over $1.3 million. Dennis requested any bonus be prorated to the date of the twins' graduations instead of his full 2026 income.

Many have noted that Savoie is a year younger than Jack, though that issue has never been addressed publicly by either person. As it stands, Dennis and Savoie are one of Hollywood's[most successful age gap relationships](https://www.thelist.com/1181867/the-most-successful-age-gap-relationships/).However, when the news of Dennis' engagement with Savoie hit the headlines, it did spark a little teasing from his "Parent Trap" co-star Elaine Hendrix, who quipped on [X](https://x.com/elaine4animals/status/1186349536609996800?s=20), "Watch out for those twins." In the 1998 comedy, Hendrix played Meredith Blake, the much younger fiancée of Dennis' character, Nick Parker. Lindsay Lohan played Parkers' twin girls, who are determined to break them up to reunite him with their birth mother.

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie have never let their 39-year age difference define their relationship.

The couple met at a business event in 2019 and married in an intimate seaside ceremony the following year. Dennis was 66, while Laura was 27.

Six years later, they remain together and also work side by side through the production company they co-founded. Quaid has described Laura as the love of his life and called their marriage the closest relationship he has ever experienced.

Do you believe age matters when two people have found the right connection?

# Dennis Quaid says 'every day is paradise' with wife 39 years his junior

## 71-year-old 'Sovereign' star opens up about his life with wife Laura Savoie, 32

[![Image 47: Emily Trainham](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2026/06/340/340/fox_news_digital_square_profile_default_2.png?ve=1&tl=1)](https://www.foxnews.com/person/t/emily-trainham) By [Emily Trainham](https://www.foxnews.com/person/t/emily-trainham) , [Larry Fink](https://www.foxnews.com/person/f/larry-fink)[Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/)

[Dennis Quaid](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/reagan-star-dennis-quaid-rallies-trump-coachella-california-time-pick-side) is living the dream.

It's been five years since the "Sovereign" star, 71, married Laura Savoie, 32, and he's still firmly in the honeymoon stage.

"My life is paradise," Quaid told Fox News Digital when asked what he loves most about his wife. "Every day is paradise with her. It really is."

[**DENNIS QUAID DEVASTATED BY CLOSE FAMILY CONNECTION TO TEXAS FLOODS**](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/dennis-quaid-devastated-close-family-connection-texas-floods)

![Image 49: Dennis Quaid and wife Laura Savoie](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2025/07/1200/675/dennis-quaid-laura-savoie.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)

Dennis Quaid married wife Laura Savoie five years ago in an intimate ceremony in Santa Barbara.(Catherine Powell/Getty Images for CMT)

He continued, "It's the [closest relationship](https://www.foxnews.com/category/entertainment/events/couples) I've ever had with anybody. Every day is paradise. What can I tell you? I don't know why God had waited so long to bring her, for her to come along, but [I'm] really glad he brought her into my life, or I walked into hers."

The couple married in June 2020 in Santa Barbara, California, after meeting a year earlier at a business event while she was working toward her second master’s degree at the Texas McCombs School of Business, according to her LinkedIn profile.

There's a significant age difference between the two, but as Quaid told Fox News Digital last year, he doesn't notice it.

![Image 50: Dennis Quaid and wife Laua Savoie smile for portrait with palm tree in background](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2023/08/1200/675/dennis-quaid-laura-savoie-2.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)

Dennis Quaid has said faith plays a big role in his marriage with Laura Savoie.(Daniele Venturelli)

"I haven't spoken out about the [age difference](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/dennis-quaid-credits-god-happy-marriage-light-my-life) of my wife. Other people have. But…I really don't think about it," he admitted. "She's got so much going on that, you know, I just don't notice it. She's just, she's the light of my life."

"I wasn’t looking for it, and she came along, and it's God put us together," he added.

![Image 51: Dennis Quaid speaking into a microphone outside at a Trump campaign event](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2025/07/1200/675/dennis-quaid-speaking.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)

Dennis Quaid denied "looking for an age gap" when he met Savoie.(Mario Tama/Getty Images)

In 2019, after Quaid became engaged to Savoie, he told [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2019/nov/25/dennis-quaid-i-didnt-go-looking-for-someone-younger-on-his-new-love-and-new-roles) that all the attention they'd received for their age gap was "really a laugh."

He explained, "I didn’t go out looking for an age gap or someone really younger than me. I met her at a business event and then the relationship developed. You have no control over who you fall in love with. I don’t fall in love easy. But I can’t let what a few people think control all that. I’ve been married three times and this is the final one, I know it is. I feel like I have a real partner in life."

[**HARRISON FORD, CHER AND DENNIS QUAID MAKE HOLLYWOOD ROMANCES LAST DESPITE LARGE AGE GAPS**](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/harrison-ford-cher-dennis-quaid-make-hollywood-romances-last-despite-age-gaps)

Quaid's first wife was actress P.J. Soles. They were married in 1978 and split five years later. In 1991, he and [Meg Ryan](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/meg-ryan-says-not-good-famous-person-launches-hollywood-comeback) were wed, and in 2004, three years after divorcing the "When Harry Met Sally" star, he married real estate broker Kimberly Buffington. They divorced in 2018.

"It really doesn't bother us," he told The Guardian of the backlash to his engagement with Savoie. "Everyone comes from the perspective of their own life and so I can’t comment on the way they feel; I can’t even get angry."

![Image 52: A photo of Dennis Quaid with wife Laura Savoie.](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2023/08/1200/675/dennis-quaid-laura-savoie.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)

Laura Savoie is Dennis Quaid's fourth wife.(Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images)

The couple had originally planned a Hawaiian wedding, but when the COVID-19 pandemic hit, their plans shifted.

Instead of their planned nuptials, they eloped: on June 2, 2020, they were married at a seaside resort in Santa Barbara, California, with only their pastor as their witness.

"Just looking into her eyes, she was the most stunning bride," Quaid told [People](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-and-laura-savoie-are-married/) of the intimate affair.

Savoie told the outlet that she has "never met someone who is so in love with life. It's like nothing can bring him down."

She added, "Just getting to do life with someone who lives that way is inspiring for me. It changes my perspective and it brings so much joy to every day."

![Image 53: Dennis Quaid and wife Laura Savoie Quaid at the premiere of "Reagan"](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2024/08/1200/675/Dennis-Quaid-Laura-Savoie-Reagan-premiere.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie Quaid attend the Los Angeles Premiere of "Reagan" at TCL Chinese Theatre on August 20, 2024, in Hollywood, California.(Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic)

"It was love at first sight," Quaid insisted. "I just love who she is as a person. Her character, her intelligence, of course, her beauty. And her point of view of the world."

He repeated similar sentiments about the difference in their ages, telling [People](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-says-it-was-love-at-first-sight-with-new-wife-laura-savoie/), "There's just something timeless about us, while Savoie said that she appreciates certain things about her husband's maturity, "like the wisdom that Dennis has."

"We both had to go through things to be who we are now and who we are now was ready for each other."

![Image 54: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie](https://a57.foxnews.com/static.foxnews.com/foxnews.com/content/uploads/2025/07/1200/675/dennis-quaid-laura-savoie-2.jpg?ve=1&tl=1)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie attend the 71st Taormina Film Festival on June 12, 2025 in Taormina, Italy.(Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images)

According to Quaid, their [shared faith](https://www.foxnews.com/faith-values) played a role in their quick connection as well.

"We’re both Christians, and right from the start God has always had a hand in the relationship," he said. "I think that’s where the real strength comes from."

source_reported.title: Dennis Quaid says 'every day is paradise' with wife 39 years his junior

chunks.text:
Dennis Quaid experienced "love at first sight" with his wife, Laura Savoie.
The two met at a business event in 2019 and got married a year later in June 2020.
Savoie is _The Parent Trap_ star's fourth wife. He was previously married to P.J. Soles from 1978 to 1983, Meg Ryan from 1991 to 2001 and Kimberly Buffington from 2004 to 2018. He shares son Jack with Ryan and twins Thomas and Zoe with Buffington.
In December 2021, Quaid and Savoie founded the production company Bonniedale Films.
“Laura's the love of my life,”Quaid told PEOPLE in July 2023. “She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before. It's a joy of life that we share together.”
So, who is the actor's fourth wife? Here is everything to know about Laura Savoie, Dennis Quaid's wife.

## **She graduated from Pepperdine University**
Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie in 2025.  
Kevin Mazur/Getty
Originally from St. Louis, Savoie obtained her undergraduate degree in accounting from Pepperdine University. According to her LinkedIn profile, she not only completed her bachelor's degree in three years, but she was also the valedictorian of her graduating class.
Savoie also earned a master's degree in accounting, financial reporting and assurance services from the University of Notre Dame.
When she and Quaid met and began dating, she was working toward her PhD at the University of Texas at Austin.

## **She is a certified public accountant and holds a real estate license**
Terry Wyatt/WireImage
Savoie became a certified public accountant in the state of California in 2015, per her LinkedIn bio. A year later, she obtained her real estate license.
From 2015 to 2017, Savoie was employed at the accounting firm Ernst & Young in Los Angeles, where she worked with clients in the "real estate, biopharmaceutical, retail consumer products, media and entertainment" industries as part of the company's assurance team.
headings: ## **She is a certified public accountant and holds a real estate license**

chunks.text:
## **She's a registered yoga instructor**
In addition to her various business endeavors, Savoie is also a registered yoga instructor, per her LinkedIn.
Quaid also enjoys practicing yoga. In 2018, he told _Men's Health_ that he changed up his exercise routine as he got older.
"I turned to cycling, which I'm currently doing. That and yoga. Along with that, you got to still get into the gym and lift. Do the sit-ups," he said.

## **She has done a lot of volunteer work**
Marco Garcia/Getty
Savoie has spent a good deal of her time giving back to various causes. Her LinkedIn profile lists several volunteer organizations that she has been a part of over the years, including Baja Build, Standing on Stone Malibu Community Outreach, Fiji Kinde Project and Oasis of Hollywood.
headings: ## **She has done a lot of volunteer work**

chunks.text:
## **She and Quaid met in 2019**
The couple met in 2019 at a business event after being introduced by a mutual friend. Quaid later told PEOPLE it was "love at first sight."
"I just love who she is as a person. Her character, her intelligence, of course, her beauty. And her point of view of the world," he added.

## **She loves to travel with Quaid**
Flightrisk / BACKGRID
Over the past couple of years, Savoie and Quaid have done plenty of traveling together. Shortly after PEOPLE confirmed the two were dating, they were spotted in Lake Como, Italy. A couple of months later, they were seen paddleboarding on a beach in Waikiki, Hawaii.
Quaid and Savoie have grown fond of Hawaii and have traveled to the state quite a few times over the course of their relationship. In fact, Quaid popped the question during a trip to Oahu.
"I had the ring in my pocket … It has been kind of a month-and-a-half plan … I wanted it to be private," Quaid told _Extra_ in October 2019. "She was actually taking a selfie of us, and I put the ring in front and said, 'Will you marry me?' — and then she fell down," he added.

## **She and Quaid got married in 2020**
Dennis Quaid Laura Savoie.Elizabeth Messina
Quaid and Savoie had originally planned to get married in Hawaii in April 2020 with a reception to be held at a later date in Nashville, but the couple were forced to postpone their plans due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
The pair decided they didn't want to wait to exchange vows, so they eloped in Santa Barbara at a seaside resort on June 2, 2020, with their pastor as the only witness present. The bride wore a Chosen By One Day gown, while the groom chose a light gray Hugo Boss suit.
"It was beautiful," Quaid told PEOPLE of the intimate ceremony.

## **She and Quaid have a shared faith**
Daniele Venturelli/Getty
Shortly after their wedding, the couple opened up about their shared faith with PEOPLE, explaining that it is their "greatest source of strength." Quaid and Savoie also revealed that it helped get them through the COVID-19 pandemic.
"With the quarantine, it hasn't been easy," Savoie said. "And when you just pray together and say that this is where I'm having a hard time, help us be the people we're supposed to be towards each other. It changes everything."
She continued, "It brings you back to being loving and kind towards each other and working through those things that inevitably come up. And it's just the greatest source of strength in our relationship to have, to share that."
In July 2023, Quaid told PEOPLE that his and Savoie's faith is key to the success of their marriage. “God is in the relationship,” he explained. “I've never had a relationship like that before."
headings: ## **She and Quaid have a shared faith**

chunks.text:
## **She and Quaid "don't even notice" their age gap**
Quaid is 39 years older than Savoie,but that doesn't phase the couple. During an interview on the _Today_ show, Quaid said: "There's 30-something years between us, and we just don't even notice it. I've never related to someone in my life better than we do."
He continued, "We have such a great relationship and you know, love finds a way, wherever it is. You never know when love is coming, who it's gonna be, and you have no control over it. We just couldn't be happier."
The actor had previously told PEOPLE that their age difference just "doesn't come up." He said, "There's just something timeless about us. We're partners in our relationship and in life. It's love. And love just has a way of surprising you."
headings: ## **She and Quaid "don't even notice" their age gap**

chunks.text:
## She and Quaid launched a production company together
Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie in 2024.  
Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic
In December 2021, Quaid and Savoie teamed up to launch the production company Bonniedale Films, along with co-founder Ben Howard, per Deadline. Their first film under the company will be _American Pride_, an upcoming biopic of country star Charley Pride.
Howard, who produced the Quaid-starring film _Blue Miracle_, said in a statement at the time, "I'm excited to work with Dennis and Laura in making the world a better place through the films, shows and content we develop and produce."
The production company is based in Nashville, where the couple live.
headings: ## She and Quaid launched a production company together

chunks.text:
## She is supportive of Quaid's career
Scott Kirkland/Shutterstock
In addition to being one of Hollywood's most iconic actors, Quaid is also the lead singer and guitarist of his band Dennis Quaid and The Sharks.
Savoie has supported her husband at concerts, award shows and movie premieres over the years, including the2022 CMT Awardsand a Los Angeles screening of Quaid's latest film _The Long Game_ in April 2024.
headings: ## She is supportive of Quaid's career

chunks.text:
## She and Quaid are true crime fans
Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie in 2024.  
Mindy Small/FilmMagi
While speaking to PEOPLE in March 2025, Quaid revealed that he and Savoie often "fall asleep to _Dateline_." He said they particularly enjoy the "murder stories."
However, Savoie was slightly creeped out by her husband's latest role as the Happy Face KillerKeith Jespersonin the Paramount+ series_Happy Face_.
"That'd be creepy for me too, but she knows me," he told _Fox News_ before the show premiered on March 20.
headings: ## She and Quaid are true crime fans

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie in 2024.

#### Actor Dennis Quaid praises efforts made by Texas first-responders
Actor Dennis Quaid joins Fox News contributor Kellyanne Conway to bring awareness to the search and recovery work in Texas after devastating floods on 'Hannity.'
NEW You can now listen to Fox News articles!
Dennis Quaid is living the dream.
It's been five years since the "Sovereign" star, 71, married Laura Savoie, 32, and he's still firmly in the honeymoon stage.
"My life is paradise," Quaid told Fox News Digital when asked what he loves most about his wife. "Every day is paradise with her. It really is."
**DENNIS QUAID DEVASTATED BY CLOSE FAMILY CONNECTION TO TEXAS FLOODS**
Dennis Quaid married wife Laura Savoie five years ago in an intimate ceremony in Santa Barbara.(Catherine Powell/Getty Images for CMT)
He continued, "It's the closest relationship I've ever had with anybody. Every day is paradise. What can I tell you? I don't know why God had waited so long to bring her, for her to come along, but [I'm] really glad he brought her into my life, or I walked into hers."
The couple married in June 2020 in Santa Barbara, California, after meeting a year earlier at a business event while she was working toward her second master’s degree at the Texas McCombs School of Business, according to her LinkedIn profile.
There's a significant age difference between the two, but as Quaid told Fox News Digital last year, he doesn't notice it.
Dennis Quaid has said faith plays a big role in his marriage with Laura Savoie.(Daniele Venturelli)
"I haven't spoken out about the age difference of my wife. Other people have. But…I really don't think about it," he admitted. "She's got so much going on that, you know, I just don't notice it. She's just, she's the light of my life."
"I wasn’t looking for it, and she came along, and it's God put us together," he added.

## 71-year-old 'Sovereign' star opens up about his life with wife Laura Savoie, 32
#### Actor Dennis Quaid praises efforts made by Texas first-responders
**CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR THE ENTERTAINMENT NEWSLETTER**
Dennis Quaid denied "looking for an age gap" when he met Savoie.(Mario Tama/Getty Images)
In 2019, after Quaid became engaged to Savoie, he told The Guardian that all the attention they'd received for their age gap was "really a laugh."
He explained, "I didn’t go out looking for an age gap or someone really younger than me. I met her at a business event and then the relationship developed. You have no control over who you fall in love with. I don’t fall in love easy. But I can’t let what a few people think control all that. I’ve been married three times and this is the final one, I know it is. I feel like I have a real partner in life."
**HARRISON FORD, CHER AND DENNIS QUAID MAKE HOLLYWOOD ROMANCES LAST DESPITE LARGE AGE GAPS**
Quaid's first wife was actress P.J. Soles. They were married in 1978 and split five years later. In 1991, he and Meg Ryan were wed, and in 2004, three years after divorcing the "When Harry Met Sally" star, he married real estate broker Kimberly Buffington. They divorced in 2018.
"It really doesn't bother us," he told The Guardian of the backlash to his engagement with Savoie. "Everyone comes from the perspective of their own life and so I can’t comment on the way they feel; I can’t even get angry."
Laura Savoie is Dennis Quaid's fourth wife.(Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images)
The couple had originally planned a Hawaiian wedding, but when the COVID-19 pandemic hit, their plans shifted.
Instead of their planned nuptials, they eloped: on June 2, 2020, they were married at a seaside resort in Santa Barbara, California, with only their pastor as their witness.

"Just looking into her eyes, she was the most stunning bride," Quaid told People of the intimate affair.
Savoie told the outlet that she has "never met someone who is so in love with life. It's like nothing can bring him down."
She added, "Just getting to do life with someone who lives that way is inspiring for me. It changes my perspective and it brings so much joy to every day."
Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie Quaid attend the Los Angeles Premiere of "Reagan" at TCL Chinese Theatre on August 20, 2024, in Hollywood, California.(Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic)
"It was love at first sight," Quaid insisted. "I just love who she is as a person. Her character, her intelligence, of course, her beauty. And her point of view of the world."

"We both had to go through things to be who we are now and who we are now was ready for each other."
Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie attend the 71st Taormina Film Festival on June 12, 2025 in Taormina, Italy.(Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images)
According to Quaid, their shared faith played a role in their quick connection as well.
"We’re both Christians, and right from the start God has always had a hand in the relationship," he said. "I think that’s where the real strength comes from."
