# Dennis Quaid says 'every day is paradise' with wife 39 years his junior
## 71-year-old 'Sovereign' star opens up about his life with wife Laura Savoie, 32
#### Actor Dennis Quaid praises efforts made by Texas first-responders
Actor Dennis Quaid joins Fox News contributor Kellyanne Conway to bring awareness to the search and recovery work in Texas after devastating floods on 'Hannity.'
NEW You can now listen to Fox News articles!
Dennis Quaid is living the dream.
It's been five years since the "Sovereign" star, 71, married Laura Savoie, 32, and he's still firmly in the honeymoon stage.
"My life is paradise," Quaid told Fox News Digital when asked what he loves most about his wife. "Every day is paradise with her. It really is."
**DENNIS QUAID DEVASTATED BY CLOSE FAMILY CONNECTION TO TEXAS FLOODS**
Dennis Quaid married wife Laura Savoie five years ago in an intimate ceremony in Santa Barbara.(Catherine Powell/Getty Images for CMT)
He continued, "It's the closest relationship I've ever had with anybody. Every day is paradise. What can I tell you? I don't know why God had waited so long to bring her, for her to come along, but [I'm] really glad he brought her into my life, or I walked into hers."
The couple married in June 2020 in Santa Barbara, California, after meeting a year earlier at a business event while she was working toward her second master’s degree at the Texas McCombs School of Business, according to her LinkedIn profile.
There's a significant age difference between the two, but as Quaid told Fox News Digital last year, he doesn't notice it.
Dennis Quaid has said faith plays a big role in his marriage with Laura Savoie.(Daniele Venturelli)
"I haven't spoken out about the age difference of my wife. Other people have. But…I really don't think about it," he admitted. "She's got so much going on that, you know, I just don't notice it. She's just, she's the light of my life."
"I wasn’t looking for it, and she came along, and it's God put us together," he added.

Dennis Quaid denied "looking for an age gap" when he met Savoie.(Mario Tama/Getty Images)
In 2019, after Quaid became engaged to Savoie, he told The Guardian that all the attention they'd received for their age gap was "really a laugh."
He explained, "I didn’t go out looking for an age gap or someone really younger than me. I met her at a business event and then the relationship developed. You have no control over who you fall in love with. I don’t fall in love easy. But I can’t let what a few people think control all that. I’ve been married three times and this is the final one, I know it is. I feel like I have a real partner in life."
**HARRISON FORD, CHER AND DENNIS QUAID MAKE HOLLYWOOD ROMANCES LAST DESPITE LARGE AGE GAPS**
Quaid's first wife was actress P.J. Soles. They were married in 1978 and split five years later. In 1991, he and Meg Ryan were wed, and in 2004, three years after divorcing the "When Harry Met Sally" star, he married real estate broker Kimberly Buffington. They divorced in 2018.
"It really doesn't bother us," he told The Guardian of the backlash to his engagement with Savoie. "Everyone comes from the perspective of their own life and so I can’t comment on the way they feel; I can’t even get angry."
Laura Savoie is Dennis Quaid's fourth wife.(Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images)
The couple had originally planned a Hawaiian wedding, but when the COVID-19 pandemic hit, their plans shifted.
Instead of their planned nuptials, they eloped: on June 2, 2020, they were married at a seaside resort in Santa Barbara, California, with only their pastor as their witness.

# Dennis Quaid says 'every day is paradise' with wife 39 years his junior
## 71-year-old 'Sovereign' star opens up about his life with wife Laura Savoie, 32
#### Actor Dennis Quaid praises efforts made by Texas first-responders
"Just looking into her eyes, she was the most stunning bride," Quaid told People of the intimate affair.
Savoie told the outlet that she has "never met someone who is so in love with life. It's like nothing can bring him down."
She added, "Just getting to do life with someone who lives that way is inspiring for me. It changes my perspective and it brings so much joy to every day."
Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie Quaid attend the Los Angeles Premiere of "Reagan" at TCL Chinese Theatre on August 20, 2024, in Hollywood, California.(Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic)
"It was love at first sight," Quaid insisted. "I just love who she is as a person. Her character, her intelligence, of course, her beauty. And her point of view of the world."
**CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR THE ENTERTAINMENT NEWSLETTER**
He repeated similar sentiments about the difference in their ages, telling People, "There's just something timeless about us, while Savoie said that she appreciates certain things about her husband's maturity, "like the wisdom that Dennis has."
"We both had to go through things to be who we are now and who we are now was ready for each other."
Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie attend the 71st Taormina Film Festival on June 12, 2025 in Taormina, Italy.(Daniele Venturelli/Getty Images)
According to Quaid, their shared faith played a role in their quick connection as well.
"We’re both Christians, and right from the start God has always had a hand in the relationship," he said. "I think that’s where the real strength comes from."

Six years later, they remain together and also work side by side through the production company they co-founded. Quaid has described Laura as the love of his life and called their marriage the closest relationship he has ever experienced.

# Dennis Quaid Makes Red Carpet Appearance with Wife Laura Savoie Days After 70th Birthday

The veteran actor and his wife stepped out together for an L.A. screening of his new film 'The Long Game'

By

[Julia Moore](https://people.com/author/julia-moore/)

![Image 1: julia moore - people staff portraits](https://people.com/thmb/aMu5VkElErvlmG9Uj43LluymGDQ=/200x200/filters:no_upscale():max_bytes(150000):strip_icc():format(webp)/Julia-Moore-5c68c05f4b2140cbb09ecf7acea862ff.jpg)

Dennis Quaid (L) and Laura Savoie (R) attend a screening of 'The Long Game' in Los Angeles on April 10.Credit : 
Scott Kirkland/Shutterstock

[Dennis Quaid](https://people.com/tag/dennis-quaid/) and his wife [Laura Savoie](https://people.com/movies/who-is-laura-savoie-dennis-quaid-wife/) turned the red carpet into a date night!

On April 10, [_The Parent Trap_](https://people.com/movies/the-parent-trap-cast-where-are-they-now/) star stepped out for a screening of his latest film, _The Long Game_, with his wife in Los Angeles just one day after celebrating his 70th birthday.

The actor was looking smart in a leather jacket, button-down shirt and pants, while Savoie, 30, bared some skin in a one-shoulder black top with a cutout on her midriff, along with a pair of classic white trousers.

_The Long Game_, which also stars [Jay Hernandez](https://people.com/tv/magnum-pi-jay-hernandez-higgins-magnum-endgame-pretty-exciting-exclusive/), Brett Cullen and [Oscar Nuñez](https://people.com/tv/the-stars-of-the-office-where-are-they-now/), sees Quaid help JB Peña (Hernandez) start a golf team for Mexican-American kids after facing discrimination in Texas. The film, based on Humberto G. Garcia's 2010 novel, _Mustang Miracle_, tells the true story of how Peña's group of high schoolers made history with their victory in the 1957 Texas state golf championship. The film originally premiered at SXSW in 2023, and Savoie joined Quaid on the red carpet for the debut, as well.

[Julianne Moore and Dennis Quaid Reunite 21 Years After _Far From Heaven_: 'Wonderful Coincidence'](https://people.com/julianne-moore-dennis-quaid-reunite-21-years-after-far-from-heaven-8407849)

![Image 5: Dennis Quaid attends "The Long Game" Nosotros community screening and reception at The Montalban on April 10, 2024 in Hollywood, California.](https://people.com/thmb/k3wvQknYma0Imy7PzBSgyRSgj00=/4000x0/filters:no_upscale():max_bytes(150000):strip_icc():focal(666x0:668x2):format(webp)/dennis-quaid-the-long-game-screening-041124-64ff02f29330418eb2a50de0aa2d0225.jpg)

Dennis Quaid.
JC Olivera/Getty

Last year, the actor raved to PEOPLE about his wife, who he met in 2019 and [married in secret](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-and-laura-savoie-are-married/) a year later, describing their life together as "heaven."

“[Laura's the love of my life](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-talks-about-love-of-my-life-laura-savoie-7565513),” he said of the real estate agent. “She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before.

“I like waking up together. I like every moment of the day because we can do just simple stuff and it makes it worthwhile. It's a joy of life that we share together.”

[Dennis Quaid Admits He's a 'Dorky Dad' to His Three Kids: 'Teenagers Are Awkward' (Exclusive)](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-says-hes-a-dorky-dad-to-his-kids-exclusive-7566645)

Among the things that made their relationship work, he continued, was that he's taken lessons from his previous relationships. Quaid was [previously married](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaids-ups-and-downs-cocaine-addiction-meg-ryan/) to P.J. Soles from 1978 to 1983, [Meg Ryan](https://people.com/movies/meg-ryan-life-and-career-in-photos/) from 1991 to 2001 and Kimberly Buffington from 2004 to 2018. He shares son [Jack](https://people.com/meg-ryan-recalls-seeing-son-jack-quaid-act-in-a-middle-school-play-and-realizing-his-talent-i-just-knew-8409226), 31, with Ryan, and twins [Thomas and Zoe](https://people.com/parents/all-about-dennis-quaid-kids/), 16, with Buffington.

He told PEOPLE he's learned “to let go of a lot of things," which has helped pave the way for his and Savoie's love story.

"I think you have to prepare a table for love and tend to it. That’s what love is," he continued. “That’s what Laura and I have. I was ready to meet her, and I don’t know why God had it that we met at the time that we did, but it’s it for me. It’s great."

![Image 7: Dennis Quaid and fiancee Laura Savoie](https://people.com/thmb/mx4i0mcBIoVZ0tkbqHeSkPZoMik=/4000x0/filters:no_upscale():max_bytes(150000):strip_icc():focal(739x0:741x2):format(webp)/dennis-quaid-2-1-c89e3d1b4b3542caa3e4e587ff32292d.jpg)

Dennis Quaid (L) and Laura Savoie (R).Marco Garcia/Getty

The couple split their time between Los Angeles and Nashville, where Savoie is a real estate agent, and enjoy date nights in the Tennessee city frequently.

As for their [nearly four decade age gap](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-on-39-year-age-gap-between-him-and-wife-you-have-no-control-over-who-you-love/), Quaid said, "We just never noticed it right from the beginning and just had to go with it."

He described himself as the "happiest I've ever been."

![Image 9: Dennis Quaid attends the 31st Annual MovieGuide Awards Gala at Avalon Hollywood & Bardot on February 09, 2024 in Los Angeles, California. ](https://people.com/thmb/UJYY1_1RwcadvYvam39WcIDDhaE=/4000x0/filters:no_upscale():max_bytes(150000):strip_icc():focal(999x0:1001x2):format(webp)/dennis-quaid-movieguide-awards-gala-041124-e897a3c514ca45ff8e1e91730fde2525.jpg)

Dennis Quaid attends the 31st Annual MovieGuide Awards Gala on February 9, 2024.
Frazer Harrison/Getty

Quaid and Savoie announced their marriage exclusively to PEOPLE, [spilling the details on their "beautiful" elopement in Santa Barbara](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-and-laura-savoie-are-married/) in June 2020.

"It was love at first sight," the actor said of Savoie, before listing the things he loves about her. "Her character, her intelligence, of course, her beauty. And her point of view of the world."

The St. Louis native also shared her thoughts on Quaid, as she admitted she had "never met someone who is so in love with life."

"It's like nothing can bring him down," she continued. "Just getting to do life with someone who lives that way is inspiring for me. It changes my perspective and it brings so much joy to every day."

Multi-hyphenate Dennis Quaid is an EMMY® AWARD and two-time GOLDEN GLOBE®-celebrated actor whose unprecedented career spans more than 50 years, over 80 films, and more than 20 television projects. The GOLDEN GLOBES have honored him with two nominations for his performances in FAR FROM HEAVEN and THE SPECIAL RELATIONSHIP. Throughout his career, Quaid has been admired for his roles in blockbuster sports film including THE ROOKIE, BREAKING AWAY, ANY GIVEN SUNDAY, TOUGH ENOUGH, AMERICAN UNDERDOG, EVERYBODY’S ALL-AMERICAN, and many more. Recently, he starred alongside Demi Moore in the ACADEMY AWARD® and GOLDEN GLOBE®-nominated film THE SUBSTANCE as well as the critically acclaimed SOVEREIGN and BROKE, and the PARAMOUNT+ series HAPPY FACE. Quaid’s robust credits in globally beloved films span all genres, including THE PARENT TRAP, THE DAY AFTER TOMORROW, REAGAN, TRAFFIC, VANTAGE POINT, FREQUENCY, SOUL SURFER, THE RIGHT STUFF, A DOG’S JOURNEY, A DOG’S PURPOSE, and I CAN ONLY IMAGINE, as well as standout roles in TV series and limited series such as PARAMOUNT+’s BASS REEVES and the MAX miniseries FULL CIRCLE. Quaid and his wife, Laura Savoie, have also founded the production company BONNIEDALE, marking their entry into film production. Their first movie, THE LONG GAME, is a sports drama that won the AUDIENCE AWARD at the 2023 SXSW FILM FESTIVAL. Quaid is represented by UTA, ADKINS ENTERTAINMENT and HANSEN, JACOBSON, TELLER.

When **Laura Savoie** married Hollywood actor Dennis Quaid in 2020, much of the public attention surrounding the couple focused on their **39-year age difference**. Yet her own story extends well beyond her marriage. Before entering the entertainment spotlight, Savoie had already developed an impressive background in accounting, corporate assurance, higher education and university teaching.

Today, she combines that financial experience with the entertainment industry as a **founding partner of Bonniedale Films**. Her professional journey includes **Pepperdine University, the University of Notre Dame, Ernst & Young (EY), the University of Texas at Austin**, and a producer credit on **The Long Game**, establishing a career identity separate from her husband’s fame.

## Quick Facts

| Field | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Full Name | **Laura Elizabeth Savoie** |
| Known As | **Laura Savoie Quaid** |
| Age | **33 years old in 2026** |
| Hometown | **St. Louis, Missouri** |
| Nationality | **American** |
| Profession | **CPA, business professional and film producer** |
| Undergraduate Education | **Pepperdine University, Class of 2014** |
| Graduate Education | **University of Notre Dame, Class of 2015** |
| Professional Credential | **Certified Public Accountant** |
| Former Employer | **Ernst & Young (EY), Los Angeles** |
| Husband | **Dennis Quaid** |
| Marriage Date | **June 2, 2020** |
| Production Company | **Bonniedale Films** |

## Academic Excellence and Early Career

Laura Savoie grew up in **St. Louis, Missouri**, and initially followed a professional path centered on business and accounting rather than entertainment. She attended **[Pepperdine University](https://www.pepperdine.edu/)**, where she completed her undergraduate accounting studies in three years and graduated in **2014 as valedictorian**.

She then continued her education at the **[University of Notre Dame](https://www.nd.edu/)**, earning a **Master of Science in Accountancy in 2015**. Savoie graduated **magna cum laude**, adding another major academic achievement to an already distinguished educational record.

Her strong academic foundation eventually supported a career that moved between corporate accounting, university-level study and entertainment-business management.

## Ernst & Young Experience and Professional Credentials

After graduate school, Savoie entered the professional accounting sector and worked at **Ernst & Young (EY)** in Los Angeles between **2015 and 2017**. She worked within the firm’s assurance practice, gaining firsthand experience with financial reporting and business operations across several commercial industries.

Her professional exposure included clients in areas such as **real estate, biopharmaceuticals, retail consumer products, media and entertainment**. That experience placed her inside one of the world’s major accounting firms before she later moved into advanced academic study.

Savoie’s accounting credentials became particularly relevant later when she moved into film production, where budgeting, financial oversight and business planning are essential parts of developing entertainment projects.

## Doctoral Study and Teaching at Texas McCombs

Savoie eventually returned to academia at the **University of Texas at Austin’s McCombs School of Business**, where she pursued advanced study in accounting. During the period when her relationship with Dennis Quaid became public in 2019, she was deeply involved in doctoral-level academic work.

Her connection with McCombs was not limited to studying. In **summer 2019**, she served as an instructor for **Fundamentals of Financial Accounting**, a university course dealing with financial statements, business transactions and the interpretation of accounting information.

Her Texas McCombs experience included:

*   Advanced study in **accounting**
*   University-level teaching responsibilities
*   Teaching **Fundamentals of Financial Accounting**
*   Applying her **CPA background** in an academic environment

This part of her career is especially notable because Savoie entered public life with professional and teaching experience already established, rather than building a career only after marrying a Hollywood celebrity.

## How Laura Savoie Met Dennis Quaid

![Image 1](https://totalmagazine.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Who-Is-Laura-Savoie-Dennis-Quaids-Wife-and-Business-Partner-2-790x443.jpg)
Laura Savoie and **Dennis Quaid met in 2019 at a business event** after being introduced through a mutual connection. At the time, Savoie was involved in graduate accounting study and teaching, while Quaid was already an internationally recognized actor with several decades of film experience.

Their relationship progressed quickly. Quaid has described their connection as **“love at first sight”** and has often emphasized Savoie’s intelligence, personality and shared values when discussing why their relationship became serious so quickly.

The relationship also placed Savoie under far greater public attention than she had previously experienced. Before meeting Quaid, her public identity had largely been centered around **education, accounting and professional achievement** rather than entertainment coverage.

## Engagement and Wedding at San Ysidro Ranch

Dennis Quaid proposed to Laura Savoie during a trip to **Oahu, Hawaii, in October 2019**. The proposal occurred while the couple were taking a photograph together, with Quaid surprising her with the engagement ring during what initially appeared to be an ordinary moment.

The couple originally planned a larger wedding in Hawaii for **April 2020**, followed by another celebration in Nashville. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted those plans, leading them to arrange a much smaller ceremony instead.

Important details from their wedding include:

*   Engagement took place in **Oahu, Hawaii**
*   Quaid proposed in **October 2019**
*   Original Hawaii wedding plans were disrupted in 2020
*   They married on **June 2, 2020**
*   Ceremony took place at **San Ysidro Ranch**
*   Their pastor was present as the witness

Savoie wore a bridal gown by **Chosen By One Day**, while Quaid wore a light gray Hugo Boss suit. The intimate Santa Barbara ceremony became a considerably more private beginning to their marriage than the larger destination celebration they had originally planned.

## Marriage, Family Life and Their 39-Year Age Difference

Laura Savoie and Dennis Quaid have a **39-year age difference**, which became one of the most discussed aspects of their relationship after their engagement became public. Quaid was born in **1954**, while Savoie is 33 years old in 2026.

Despite the public interest surrounding their ages, Quaid has consistently treated the difference as secondary to their compatibility. He has described Savoie as one of the closest relationships of his life and has emphasized that their age difference does not dominate their everyday marriage.

![Image 2](https://totalmagazine.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Who-Is-Laura-Savoie-Dennis-Quaids-Wife-and-Business-Partner-1-790x443.jpg)
Savoie also became part of Quaid’s larger family. Dennis Quaid has three children from earlier marriages: actor **[Jack Quaid](https://totalmagazine.co.uk/jack-quaid-wife-claudia-doumit/)** and twins **[Thomas Boone Quaid](https://totalmagazine.co.uk/thomas-quaid/) and [Zoe Grace Quaid](https://totalmagazine.co.uk/zoe-grace-quaid/)**.

Savoie is Quaid’s fourth wife. His previous marriages were to **P.J. Soles, Meg Ryan and [Kimberly Buffington](https://totalmagazine.co.uk/kimberly-buffington/)**. Her relationship with his family forms one part of a marriage that also includes faith, travel, music and their growing professional partnership.

## Bonniedale Films and The Long Game

In 2021, Laura Savoie and Dennis Quaid expanded their personal partnership into entertainment by co-founding **Bonniedale Films** alongside producer Ben Howard. Headquartered in Nashville, the independent production company focuses on developing character-driven, biographical, and inspirational feature projects.

*   **Executive Oversight:** Leveraging her Big Four assurance background at Ernst & Young (EY) and CPA credentials, Savoie manages production financing, budget architecture, and commercial operations rather than pursuing on-screen acting.
*   **The Long Game (2024):** Savoie earned an official producer credit on this historical sports drama following Mexican-American high school golfers in 1950s Texas.
*   **Festival & Box Office Success:** The film won the Narrative Spotlight Audience Award at the 2023 SXSW Film & TV Festival before its nationwide theatrical release in 2024.

Savoie and Quaid maintain an intentional, grounded routine centered around shared creative interests and selected public engagements:

**Private Online Footprint:** She avoids influencer-style branding, utilizing platforms like LinkedIn for professional credentials while keeping her personal life and social media accounts private.

**Nashville Base:** Living in Nashville allows the couple to manage Bonniedale Films while supporting Quaid’s gospel and Americana music career.

**Industry Red Carpets:** Savoie maintains a polished, understated public presence, accompanying Quaid to major events including the 97th Academy Awards in March 2025, CinemaCon, and film premieres.

## Conclusion

Laura Savoie first attracted widespread attention through her relationship with **Dennis Quaid**, but her professional background had been developing for years before their marriage. Her path includes graduating as **Pepperdine valedictorian**, earning a graduate degree from Notre Dame, working at **Ernst & Young (EY)**, teaching accounting at Texas McCombs and later entering film production.

Her role at **Bonniedale Films**, together with her producer credit on **The Long Game** and the film’s **SXSW Audience Award**, adds a meaningful entertainment-business dimension to her résumé. Savoie now occupies an unusual space connecting accounting, higher education, faith, business and filmmaking while maintaining a comparatively private public profile.

## FAQs

### How old is Laura Savoie?

Laura Savoie is **33 years old in 2026** and has a **39-year age difference** with her husband, actor Dennis Quaid.

### What does Laura Savoie do for a living?

She is a **CPA, business professional and film producer** who co-founded **Bonniedale Films** with Dennis Quaid and Ben Howard.

### Where did Laura Savoie go to college?

Savoie studied accounting at **Pepperdine University** and later earned a graduate accountancy degree from the **University of Notre Dame**.

### Did Laura Savoie work at Ernst & Young?

Yes. Laura Savoie worked in **Ernst & Young’s Los Angeles assurance practice** between 2015 and 2017 before returning to academia.

### What movie did Laura Savoie produce?

Laura Savoie was a credited producer of **The Long Game**, which won the **Narrative Spotlight Audience Award at SXSW** in 2023.

### How did Dennis Quaid meet his current wife?

The duo began dating shortly after meeting at a business conference venue. [According to Dennis](https://people.com/movies/dennis-quaid-says-it-was-love-at-first-sight-with-new-wife-laura-savoie/), it was love at first sight. He and Laura dated for a few months before revealing their relationship to the public.

Their first public appearance as a couple was on May 14, 2019, at a dinner event at Craig’s, West Hollywood. In 2023, the actor expressed his admiration for his wife during an [interview with _People_,](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-makes-red-carpet-appearance-with-wife-laura-savoie-days-after-70th-birthday-8629959) sharing that they met in 2019 and tied the knot secretly a year later.

He described their life together as nothing short of "heaven."

> Laura's the love of my life. She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before. I like waking up together. I like every moment of the day because we can do just simple stuff and it makes it worthwhile. It's a joy of life that we share together.

> I think you have to prepare a table for love and tend to it. That’s what love is. That’s what Laura and I have. I was ready to meet her, and I don’t know why God had it that we met at the time that we did, but it’s it for me. It’s great.

### Who are Dennis Quaid's previous wives?

#### **Dennis Quaid and P.J. Soles**

Quaid and his first wife, P.J. Soles, never had a child. They met on the set of _Our Winning Season_ film and married on November 23, 1978. At that time, the actor was 24, and Soles was 27. The couple divorced on August 23, 1983, long before he met his second wife, Ryan Meg.

#### **Dennis Quaid and Meg Ryan**

The actor and Meg Ryan fell in love[](https://hollywoodlife.com/feature/dennis-quaid-wife-4702696/)after featuring together in two movies, _Innerspace_ and _D.O.A._ They married on February 14, 1991, and ended the union on July 16, 2001. Dennis Quaid's ex-wife, Meg, was allegedly romantically involved with actor Russell Crowe around the time they ended their marriage.

> There’d be vans outside of my house with listening devices. It was the very height of Meg’s career back then, but I look back at it and it's taught me patience, I guess.

#### **Dennis Quaid and Kimberly Buffington**

Dennis married Kimberly Buffington on July 4, 2004. The couple had fraternal twins, Thomas Boone and Zoe Grace, through a surrogate on November 8, 2007, at St. John's Health Center in Santa Monica, California.

When the actor divorced Buffington on April 27, 2018, he paid her $2 million in lumpsum and $13,750 monthly in child support.

# Dennis Quaid, 65, looks dapper on the red carpet as he returns to his native Texas to debut his latest film The Long Game alongside wife Laura Savoie, 30

By [ALESIA STANFORD, WRITER](https://www.dailymail.com/profile-3526/alesia-stanford.html)

Published: 20:20 GMT, 12 March 2023  | Updated: 21:05 GMT, 12 March 2023

Share[Add us as a preferred source](https://google.com/preferences/source?q=dailymail.com)[37 comments](https://www.dailymail.com/tvshowbiz/article-11851125/Dennis-Quaid-looks-dapper-returns-native-Texas-debut-latest-film-Long-Game.html#comments)

Dennis Quaid returned to his native [Texas](https://www.dailymail.com/news/texas/index.html) for the premiere of his latest film Sunday.

The actor, 65, [who considered turning down an opportunity to star as Ronald Reagan in a biopic about the late president](https://www.dailymail.com/tvshowbiz/article-10809919/Dennis-Quaid-says-TURNED-role-Ronald-Reagan-new-biopic.html), looked dapper on the red carpet as he promoted The Long Game at the South by Southwest conference in Austin.

The Blue Miracle actor stepped out in silver, black and turquoise cowboy boots, black jeans and a black button down shirt.

His salt and pepper beard was neatly trimmed and his light brown hair was brushed away from his face.

The Independent Spirit Award winner was joined by his wife, Laura Savoie, 30, who stunned in a green, blue and white maxi dress, with puffed sleeves, a V-neck and a small cutout at the waist.

Her flaxen locks were parted on the side and styled in loose waves.

The couple tied the knot in 2020.

Dennis was excited to promote the film, which he told[Entertainment Weekly](https://ew.com/movies/dennis-quaid-the-long-game-true-story/), has a message close to his heart.

'I love underdog stories and aspirational stories. I don't think people go to see movies; they go to feel movies. And this one really got me in the right way.'

The veteran actor who starred in another underdog story as baseball pitcher Jimmy Morris in 2002's The Rookie, was pleased to be telling another true sports tale.

'When I was reading the script, I was going, this absolutely cannot be true, but yet it is.'

The film tells the story of a team of Mexican American teen golf caddies who learn to outplay the people they work for at an exclusive country club.

The teens were so eager to learn the game they had built their own golf course, and with the help of their school principal JB Peña, played by Jay Hernandez and his old war buddy Frank Miller (Quaid) go on to take on the establishment in segregated Del Rio, Texas in 1956.

The Long Game is the first to come out of of Dennis' new production company,Bonniedale.

He formed the enterprise with his wife, and his Blue Miracle producer Ben Howard, in December 2021.

'This movie's not about golf,' the father of three adamantly stated.

'It's about building character and doing the tough thing sometimes; I think that's the appeal of it.'

Dennis shares his oldest, actor Jack Quaid, 30, with ex-wife Meg Ryan, 61, and twins Thomas and Zoe, 15, from his marriage to Kimberly Buffington.

The busy actor stars alongside Cheech Marin, Jaina Lee Ortiz, Oscar Nuñez, Paulina Chávez, and Gregory Diaz IV.

The Long Game is based on the book, Mustang Miracle, written by Humberto G. Garcia.

**Laura Savoie is an American yoga instructor, certified public accountant, and licensed real estate agent. She came into the limelight after being linked to actor and singer Dennis Quaid, who she married in 2020.**

![Image 1: Dennis Quaid and his wife Laura Savoie](https://cdn.briefly.co.za/images/1120/f672ecb3b07b442c.jpeg?v=1)

Laura Savoie is Dennis Quaid's fourth wife. Photo: Terry Wyatt/Jeff Kravitz on Getty Images (modified by author)

 Source: UGC

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie have a 39-year age gap, but the actor revealed the issue does not affect them, and he is the happiest he has ever been. Before meeting _The Special Relationship_ star, Laura was accomplished professionally and academically with two master's degrees.

## Laura Savoie's profile summary and bio

**Full name**Laura Savoie
**Date of birth**21 February 1993
**Age**30 years in 2023
**Birth sign**Pisces
**Place of birth**St. Louis, Missouri, United States
**Nationality**American
**Religion**Christian
**Gender**Female
**Sexual orientation**Straight
**Marital status**Married
**Husband**Actor and singer Dennis Quaid
**Education**Pepperdine University (Accounting) University of Notre Dame (MSc) Texas McCombs School of Business (Masters)
**Profession**Certified accountant, licensed realtor, registered yoga teacher
**Known for**Being Dennis Quaid's fourth wife
**Social media**[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/laurasavoie/)

### Laura Savoie's age

Dennis Quaid's wife was born on 21 February 1993 in St. Louis, Missouri, United States. She is 30 years old as of 2023. Little is known about Laura Savoie's parents and early life since she has kept her personal life private.

### Laura Savoie's husband

Savoie met Dennis Quaid in 2019 at a [business](https://briefly.co.za/business-economy/) event after being introduced by a mutual friend. The actor proposed in October 2019 during a trip to Oahu, and they tied the knot about a year later on 2 June 2020.

The couple had initially planned to wed in Hawaii in April 2020 and then have a reception in Nashville, but they had to postpone due to the COVID-19 pandemic. They did not want to wait, so they decided to have a small ceremony in Santa Barbara at a seaside resort with the pastor as the only witness.

Dennis [told People](https://people.com/movies/who-is-laura-savoie-dennis-quaid-wife/) that it was love at first sight when he met Laura, and he loves who she is as a person. He later revealed that their shared faith is the key to their successful marriage.

![Image 2: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie during the world premiere of The Long Game at the Paramount Theatre during the 2023 SXSW Conference and Festival on 12 March 2023.](https://cdn.briefly.co.za/images/1120/6729479664d0b595.jpeg?v=1)

Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie have been married since 2020. Photo: Gary Miller

 Source: Getty Images

### Laura Savoie's education

Savoie is an alumnus of Pepperdine University, from where she graduated with a [degree in accounting](https://briefly.co.za/facts-lifehacks/top/134476-10-accounting-universities-south-africa-2022-africas-colleges/). She was the valedictorian of her graduating class with a 4.0 GPA.

She earned her Master of Science in Accounting, Financial Reporting, and Assurance Services from the University of Notre Dame. She also graduated from Texas McCombs School of Business with a master's degree.

### Laura Savoie's career

Laura became a certified public accountant in California in 2015, got her real estate license in 2016, and became a registered yoga teacher in 2016. From 2014 to 2015, she worked as a Research and Teaching Assistant at the University of Notre Dame Mendoza College of Business.

She worked at Ernst & Young's Assurance department in Los Angeles from 2015 to 2017. She later became a graduate research and teaching assistant at the University of Texas' Red McCombs [School of Business](https://briefly.co.za/50709-southern-business-school-application-forms-courses-fees-requirements.html) from 2017 to 2021.

Laura, her husband Dennis Quaid and Ben Howard co-founded Nashville-based Bonniedale Films production company in 2021. The[company's first project](https://www.imdb.com/news/ni63485367/) is the production of _American Pride,_ a biopic of Charley Pride.

![Image 3: Dennis Quaid and Laura Savoie during the 2022 CMT Music Awards at Nashville Municipal Auditorium on 11 April 2022 in Nashville, Tennessee.](https://cdn.briefly.co.za/images/1120/a848a222a883ac34.jpeg?v=1)

Laura Savoie is a certified public accountant. Photo: Mike Coppola

 Source: Getty Images

### Laura Savoie's net worth

Savoie has an estimated net worth of $300,000 in 2023. Her husband, actor Dennis Quaid, is estimated to be[worth $30 million](https://www.celebritynetworth.com/richest-celebrities/actors/dennis-quaid-net-worth/) and earns around $150,000 per episode.

## How much younger is Dennis Quaid's wife?

Laura Savoie is 39 years younger than her husband, Dennis Quaid. The actor was born on 9 April 1954 and is 69 years old as of 2023, while his wife is 30. Dennis said during an appearance [on the Today show](https://www.today.com/video/dennis-quaid-talks-about-virtual-the-parent-trap-reunion-88178245828) that their huge age difference is not an issue to them.

> There's 30-something years between us, and we just don't even notice it. I've never related to someone in my life better than we do.

## Who has Dennis Quaid been married to?

The actor has been [married four times](https://www.the-sun.com/entertainment/2968829/how-many-times-dennis-quaid-married/). His first wife was actress Pamela 'PJ' Soles from 1978 to 1983, but they had no kids together. He later met actress Meg Ryan and married her in 1991, but they divorced ten years later in 2001.

Quaid married real estate agent Kimberly Buffington in 2004. The actor filed for divorce from Kimberly in November 2012, and it was finalized six years later in 2018.

## Did Dennis Quaid and his wife have twins?

Dennis Quaid and his third wife Kimberly Buffington welcomed [twins Thomas Boone and Zoe](https://briefly.co.za/facts-lifehacks/celebrities-biographies/163398-thomas-boone-quaid-zoe-quaid-full-bio-dennis-quaids-twins/) Grace on 8 November 2007. The actor also shares a son, Jack Henry (b. April 1992), with his second wife, Meg Ryan. Jack is an actor known for _The Hunger Games, The Boys, Rampage,_ and _Harvey Girls Forever!_

## Does Dennis Quaid believe in God?

The actor believes in God. He was raised in a Christian family but was not into religion when he entered showbiz. After overcoming drug addiction in 1990, he [reconnected with his faith](https://people.com/dennis-quaid-on-faith-addiction-love-and-his-hollywood-journey-7565430) and has read different religious texts, including the Quran and the Bhagavad Gita.

In 1990, he wrote the Christian song, _On My Way to Heaven_, for his mother. He released his debut gospel album, _Fallen: A Gospel Record for Sinners,_ in July 2023.

![Image 4: Dennis Quaid performs during the 16th Annual Academy of Country Music Honors at Ryman Auditorium on 23 August 2023 in Nashville, Tennessee.](https://cdn.briefly.co.za/images/1120/bb83f9cb051f16e3.jpeg?v=1)

Dennis Quaid released his debut gospel album, Fallen, in July 2023. Photo: Jason Davis

 Source: Getty Images

Dennis Quaid seems happy in his fourth marriage, as seen from the numerous Laura Savoie photos online. The two often go to red-carpet events together and have been spotted having fun on vacations.

**READ ALSO:**[Biography of Mickey Middleton, the ex-wife of actor Bryan Cranston](https://briefly.co.za/facts-lifehacks/celebrities-biographies/163461-biography-mickey-middleton-wife-actor-bryan-cranston/)

**Briefly.co.za** highlighted lesser-known facts about Mickey Middleton. She is an American writer and was the first wife of _Breaking Bad_ star Bryan Cranston.

Mickey was married to actor Cranston from 1977 to 1982 and vanished from the limelight after their divorce. Where is Mickey Middleton today?

Source: Briefly News

# Dennis Quaid Makes Red Carpet Appearance with Wife Laura Savoie Days After 70th Birthday
The veteran actor and his wife stepped out together for an L.A. screening of his new film 'The Long Game'
By
Julia Moore
Julia Moore
Julia Moore is a TV Writer-Reporter at PEOPLE. She has been working at PEOPLE since 2022.
People Editorial Guidelines
Published on April 11, 2024 09:54AM EDT
Add Us On
Dennis Quaid (L) and Laura Savoie (R) attend a screening of 'The Long Game' in Los Angeles on April 10.Credit :   
Scott Kirkland/Shutterstock
Dennis Quaid and his wife Laura Savoie turned the red carpet into a date night!
On April 10, _The Parent Trap_ star stepped out for a screening of his latest film, _The Long Game_, with his wife in Los Angeles just one day after celebrating his 70th birthday.
The actor was looking smart in a leather jacket, button-down shirt and pants, while Savoie, 30, bared some skin in a one-shoulder black top with a cutout on her midriff, along with a pair of classic white trousers.
_The Long Game_, which also stars Jay Hernandez, Brett Cullen and Oscar Nuñez, sees Quaid help JB Peña (Hernandez) start a golf team for Mexican-American kids after facing discrimination in Texas. The film, based on Humberto G. Garcia's 2010 novel, _Mustang Miracle_, tells the true story of how Peña's group of high schoolers made history with their victory in the 1957 Texas state golf championship. The film originally premiered at SXSW in 2023, and Savoie joined Quaid on the red carpet for the debut, as well.
Julianne Moore and Dennis Quaid Reunite 21 Years After _Far From Heaven_: 'Wonderful Coincidence'
Dennis Quaid.  
JC Olivera/Getty
Last year, the actor raved to PEOPLE about his wife, who he met in 2019 and married in secret a year later, describing their life together as "heaven."

# Dennis Quaid Makes Red Carpet Appearance with Wife Laura Savoie Days After 70th Birthday
“Laura's the love of my life,” he said of the real estate agent. “She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before.
“I like waking up together. I like every moment of the day because we can do just simple stuff and it makes it worthwhile. It's a joy of life that we share together.”
Dennis Quaid Admits He's a 'Dorky Dad' to His Three Kids: 'Teenagers Are Awkward' (Exclusive)
Among the things that made their relationship work, he continued, was that he's taken lessons from his previous relationships. Quaid was previously married to P.J. Soles from 1978 to 1983, Meg Ryan from 1991 to 2001 and Kimberly Buffington from 2004 to 2018. He shares son Jack, 31, with Ryan, and twins Thomas and Zoe, 16, with Buffington.
He told PEOPLE he's learned “to let go of a lot of things," which has helped pave the way for his and Savoie's love story.
"I think you have to prepare a table for love and tend to it. That’s what love is," he continued. “That’s what Laura and I have. I was ready to meet her, and I don’t know why God had it that we met at the time that we did, but it’s it for me. It’s great."
Dennis Quaid (L) and Laura Savoie (R).Marco Garcia/Getty
The couple split their time between Los Angeles and Nashville, where Savoie is a real estate agent, and enjoy date nights in the Tennessee city frequently.
As for their nearly four decade age gap, Quaid said, "We just never noticed it right from the beginning and just had to go with it."
He described himself as the "happiest I've ever been."
Dennis Quaid attends the 31st Annual MovieGuide Awards Gala on February 9, 2024.  
Frazer Harrison/Getty
Quaid and Savoie announced their marriage exclusively to PEOPLE, spilling the details on their "beautiful" elopement in Santa Barbara in June 2020.

# Dennis Quaid Makes Red Carpet Appearance with Wife Laura Savoie Days After 70th Birthday
The veteran actor and his wife stepped out together for an L.A. screening of his new film 'The Long Game'
By
Julia Moore
Julia Moore
Julia Moore is a TV Writer-Reporter at PEOPLE. She has been working at PEOPLE since 2022.
People Editorial Guidelines
Published on April 11, 2024 09:54AM EDT
Add Us On
Dennis Quaid (L) and Laura Savoie (R) attend a screening of 'The Long Game' in Los Angeles on April 10.Credit :   
Scott Kirkland/Shutterstock
Dennis Quaid and his wife Laura Savoie turned the red carpet into a date night!
On April 10, _The Parent Trap_ star stepped out for a screening of his latest film, _The Long Game_, with his wife in Los Angeles just one day after celebrating his 70th birthday.
The actor was looking smart in a leather jacket, button-down shirt and pants, while Savoie, 30, bared some skin in a one-shoulder black top with a cutout on her midriff, along with a pair of classic white trousers.
_The Long Game_, which also stars Jay Hernandez, Brett Cullen and Oscar Nuñez, sees Quaid help JB Peña (Hernandez) start a golf team for Mexican-American kids after facing discrimination in Texas. The film, based on Humberto G. Garcia's 2010 novel, _Mustang Miracle_, tells the true story of how Peña's group of high schoolers made history with their victory in the 1957 Texas state golf championship. The film originally premiered at SXSW in 2023, and Savoie joined Quaid on the red carpet for the debut, as well.
Julianne Moore and Dennis Quaid Reunite 21 Years After _Far From Heaven_: 'Wonderful Coincidence'
Dennis Quaid.  
JC Olivera/Getty
Last year, the actor raved to PEOPLE about his wife, who he met in 2019 and married in secret a year later, describing their life together as "heaven."

# Dennis Quaid Makes Red Carpet Appearance with Wife Laura Savoie Days After 70th Birthday
“Laura's the love of my life,” he said of the real estate agent. “She came along and we have a bond with one another that I never had with anybody else before.
“I like waking up together. I like every moment of the day because we can do just simple stuff and it makes it worthwhile. It's a joy of life that we share together.”
Dennis Quaid Admits He's a 'Dorky Dad' to His Three Kids: 'Teenagers Are Awkward' (Exclusive)
Among the things that made their relationship work, he continued, was that he's taken lessons from his previous relationships. Quaid was previously married to P.J. Soles from 1978 to 1983, Meg Ryan from 1991 to 2001 and Kimberly Buffington from 2004 to 2018. He shares son Jack, 31, with Ryan, and twins Thomas and Zoe, 16, with Buffington.
He told PEOPLE he's learned “to let go of a lot of things," which has helped pave the way for his and Savoie's love story.
"I think you have to prepare a table for love and tend to it. That’s what love is," he continued. “That’s what Laura and I have. I was ready to meet her, and I don’t know why God had it that we met at the time that we did, but it’s it for me. It’s great."
Dennis Quaid (L) and Laura Savoie (R).Marco Garcia/Getty
The couple split their time between Los Angeles and Nashville, where Savoie is a real estate agent, and enjoy date nights in the Tennessee city frequently.
As for their nearly four decade age gap, Quaid said, "We just never noticed it right from the beginning and just had to go with it."
He described himself as the "happiest I've ever been."
Dennis Quaid attends the 31st Annual MovieGuide Awards Gala on February 9, 2024.  
Frazer Harrison/Getty
Quaid and Savoie announced their marriage exclusively to PEOPLE, spilling the details on their "beautiful" elopement in Santa Barbara in June 2020.

When **Laura Savoie** married Hollywood actor Dennis Quaid in 2020, much of the public attention surrounding the couple focused on their **39-year age difference**. Yet her own story extends well beyond her marriage. Before entering the entertainment spotlight, Savoie had already developed an impressive background in accounting, corporate assurance, higher education and university teaching.
Today, she combines that financial experience with the entertainment industry as a **founding partner of Bonniedale Films**. Her professional journey includes **Pepperdine University, the University of Notre Dame, Ernst & Young (EY), the University of Texas at Austin**, and a producer credit on **The Long Game**, establishing a career identity separate from her husband’s fame.

## Academic Excellence and Early Career
Laura Savoie grew up in **St. Louis, Missouri**, and initially followed a professional path centered on business and accounting rather than entertainment. She attended **Pepperdine University**, where she completed her undergraduate accounting studies in three years and graduated in **2014 as valedictorian**.
She then continued her education at the **University of Notre Dame**, earning a **Master of Science in Accountancy in 2015**. Savoie graduated **magna cum laude**, adding another major academic achievement to an already distinguished educational record.
Her strong academic foundation eventually supported a career that moved between corporate accounting, university-level study and entertainment-business management.

## Ernst & Young Experience and Professional Credentials
After graduate school, Savoie entered the professional accounting sector and worked at **Ernst & Young (EY)** in Los Angeles between **2015 and 2017**. She worked within the firm’s assurance practice, gaining firsthand experience with financial reporting and business operations across several commercial industries.
Her professional exposure included clients in areas such as **real estate, biopharmaceuticals, retail consumer products, media and entertainment**. That experience placed her inside one of the world’s major accounting firms before she later moved into advanced academic study.
Savoie’s accounting credentials became particularly relevant later when she moved into film production, where budgeting, financial oversight and business planning are essential parts of developing entertainment projects.
headings: ## Ernst & Young Experience and Professional Credentials

chunks.text:
## Doctoral Study and Teaching at Texas McCombs
Savoie eventually returned to academia at the **University of Texas at Austin’s McCombs School of Business**, where she pursued advanced study in accounting. During the period when her relationship with Dennis Quaid became public in 2019, she was deeply involved in doctoral-level academic work.
Her connection with McCombs was not limited to studying. In **summer 2019**, she served as an instructor for **Fundamentals of Financial Accounting**, a university course dealing with financial statements, business transactions and the interpretation of accounting information.
Her Texas McCombs experience included:
*   Advanced study in **accounting**  
*   University-level teaching responsibilities  
*   Teaching **Fundamentals of Financial Accounting**  
*   Applying her **CPA background** in an academic environment
This part of her career is especially notable because Savoie entered public life with professional and teaching experience already established, rather than building a career only after marrying a Hollywood celebrity.
headings: ## Doctoral Study and Teaching at Texas McCombs

chunks.text:
## How Laura Savoie Met Dennis Quaid
Laura Savoie and **Dennis Quaid met in 2019 at a business event** after being introduced through a mutual connection. At the time, Savoie was involved in graduate accounting study and teaching, while Quaid was already an internationally recognized actor with several decades of film experience.
Their relationship progressed quickly. Quaid has described their connection as **“love at first sight”** and has often emphasized Savoie’s intelligence, personality and shared values when discussing why their relationship became serious so quickly.
The relationship also placed Savoie under far greater public attention than she had previously experienced. Before meeting Quaid, her public identity had largely been centered around **education, accounting and professional achievement** rather than entertainment coverage.
headings: ## How Laura Savoie Met Dennis Quaid

chunks.text:
## Engagement and Wedding at San Ysidro Ranch
Dennis Quaid proposed to Laura Savoie during a trip to **Oahu, Hawaii, in October 2019**. The proposal occurred while the couple were taking a photograph together, with Quaid surprising her with the engagement ring during what initially appeared to be an ordinary moment.
The couple originally planned a larger wedding in Hawaii for **April 2020**, followed by another celebration in Nashville. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted those plans, leading them to arrange a much smaller ceremony instead.
Important details from their wedding include:
*   Engagement took place in **Oahu, Hawaii**  
*   Quaid proposed in **October 2019**  
*   Original Hawaii wedding plans were disrupted in 2020  
*   They married on **June 2, 2020**  
*   Ceremony took place at **San Ysidro Ranch**  
*   Their pastor was present as the witness
Savoie wore a bridal gown by **Chosen By One Day**, while Quaid wore a light gray Hugo Boss suit. The intimate Santa Barbara ceremony became a considerably more private beginning to their marriage than the larger destination celebration they had originally planned.
headings: ## Engagement and Wedding at San Ysidro Ranch

chunks.text:
## Marriage, Family Life and Their 39-Year Age Difference
Laura Savoie and Dennis Quaid have a **39-year age difference**, which became one of the most discussed aspects of their relationship after their engagement became public. Quaid was born in **1954**, while Savoie is 33 years old in 2026.
Despite the public interest surrounding their ages, Quaid has consistently treated the difference as secondary to their compatibility. He has described Savoie as one of the closest relationships of his life and has emphasized that their age difference does not dominate their everyday marriage.
Savoie also became part of Quaid’s larger family. Dennis Quaid has three children from earlier marriages: actor **Jack Quaid** and twins **Thomas Boone Quaid and Zoe Grace Quaid**.
Savoie is Quaid’s fourth wife. His previous marriages were to **P.J. Soles, Meg Ryan and Kimberly Buffington**. Her relationship with his family forms one part of a marriage that also includes faith, travel, music and their growing professional partnership.
headings: ## Marriage, Family Life and Their 39-Year Age Difference

chunks.text:
## Bonniedale Films and The Long Game
In 2021, Laura Savoie and Dennis Quaid expanded their personal partnership into entertainment by co-founding **Bonniedale Films** alongside producer Ben Howard. Headquartered in Nashville, the independent production company focuses on developing character-driven, biographical, and inspirational feature projects.
*   **Executive Oversight:** Leveraging her Big Four assurance background at Ernst & Young (EY) and CPA credentials, Savoie manages production financing, budget architecture, and commercial operations rather than pursuing on-screen acting.  
*   **The Long Game (2024):** Savoie earned an official producer credit on this historical sports drama following Mexican-American high school golfers in 1950s Texas.  
*   **Festival & Box Office Success:** The film won the Narrative Spotlight Audience Award at the 2023 SXSW Film & TV Festival before its nationwide theatrical release in 2024.
Savoie and Quaid maintain an intentional, grounded routine centered around shared creative interests and selected public engagements:
**Private Online Footprint:** She avoids influencer-style branding, utilizing platforms like LinkedIn for professional credentials while keeping her personal life and social media accounts private.
**Nashville Base:** Living in Nashville allows the couple to manage Bonniedale Films while supporting Quaid’s gospel and Americana music career.
**Industry Red Carpets:** Savoie maintains a polished, understated public presence, accompanying Quaid to major events including the 97th Academy Awards in March 2025, CinemaCon, and film premieres.
headings: ## Bonniedale Films and The Long Game

chunks.text:
## Conclusion
Laura Savoie first attracted widespread attention through her relationship with **Dennis Quaid**, but her professional background had been developing for years before their marriage. Her path includes graduating as **Pepperdine valedictorian**, earning a graduate degree from Notre Dame, working at **Ernst & Young (EY)**, teaching accounting at Texas McCombs and later entering film production.
Her role at **Bonniedale Films**, together with her producer credit on **The Long Game** and the film’s **SXSW Audience Award**, adds a meaningful entertainment-business dimension to her résumé. Savoie now occupies an unusual space connecting accounting, higher education, faith, business and filmmaking while maintaining a comparatively private public profile.

The actor and Meg Ryan fell in loveafter featuring together in two movies, _Innerspace_ and _D.O.A._ They married on February 14, 1991, and ended the union on July 16, 2001. Their son, Jack Henry Quaid, was born in Los Angeles on April 24, 1992. He is now an actor.
Dennis Quaid's ex-wife, Meg, was allegedly romantically involved with actor Russell Crowe around the time they ended their marriage.
The actor was born in New Zealand but grew up in Australia. Meg fell for Crowe on the set of their movie, _Proof of Life_, but he was not the reason her marriage with Quaid failed. She told _W Magazine_back in 2000:

# Dennis Quaid, 65, looks dapper on the red carpet as he returns to his native Texas to debut his latest film The Long Game alongside wife Laura Savoie, 30
Dennis was excited to promote the film, which he toldEntertainment Weekly, has a message close to his heart.
'I love underdog stories and aspirational stories. I don't think people go to see movies; they go to feel movies. And this one really got me in the right way.'
The veteran actor who starred in another underdog story as baseball pitcher Jimmy Morris in 2002's The Rookie, was pleased to be telling another true sports tale.
'When I was reading the script, I was going, this absolutely cannot be true, but yet it is.'
The film tells the story of a team of Mexican American teen golf caddies who learn to outplay the people they work for at an exclusive country club.
The teens were so eager to learn the game they had built their own golf course, and with the help of their school principal JB Peña, played by Jay Hernandez and his old war buddy Frank Miller (Quaid) go on to take on the establishment in segregated Del Rio, Texas in 1956.
The Long Game is the first to come out of of Dennis' new production company,Bonniedale.

# Dennis Quaid, 65, looks dapper on the red carpet as he returns to his native Texas to debut his latest film The Long Game alongside wife Laura Savoie, 30
By ALESIA STANFORD, WRITER
Published: 20:20 GMT, 12 March 2023  | Updated: 21:05 GMT, 12 March 2023
ShareAdd us as a preferred source37 comments
Dennis Quaid returned to his native Texas for the premiere of his latest film Sunday.
The actor, 65, who considered turning down an opportunity to star as Ronald Reagan in a biopic about the late president, looked dapper on the red carpet as he promoted The Long Game at the South by Southwest conference in Austin.
The Blue Miracle actor stepped out in silver, black and turquoise cowboy boots, black jeans and a black button down shirt.

# Dennis Quaid, 65, looks dapper on the red carpet as he returns to his native Texas to debut his latest film The Long Game alongside wife Laura Savoie, 30
Dennis was excited to promote the film, which he toldEntertainment Weekly, has a message close to his heart.
'I love underdog stories and aspirational stories. I don't think people go to see movies; they go to feel movies. And this one really got me in the right way.'
The veteran actor who starred in another underdog story as baseball pitcher Jimmy Morris in 2002's The Rookie, was pleased to be telling another true sports tale.
'When I was reading the script, I was going, this absolutely cannot be true, but yet it is.'
The film tells the story of a team of Mexican American teen golf caddies who learn to outplay the people they work for at an exclusive country club.
The teens were so eager to learn the game they had built their own golf course, and with the help of their school principal JB Peña, played by Jay Hernandez and his old war buddy Frank Miller (Quaid) go on to take on the establishment in segregated Del Rio, Texas in 1956.
The Long Game is the first to come out of of Dennis' new production company,Bonniedale.

He formed the enterprise with his wife, and his Blue Miracle producer Ben Howard, in December 2021.
'This movie's not about golf,' the father of three adamantly stated.
'It's about building character and doing the tough thing sometimes; I think that's the appeal of it.'
Dennis shares his oldest, actor Jack Quaid, 30, with ex-wife Meg Ryan, 61, and twins Thomas and Zoe, 15, from his marriage to Kimberly Buffington.
The busy actor stars alongside Cheech Marin, Jaina Lee Ortiz, Oscar Nuñez, Paulina Chávez, and Gregory Diaz IV.
The Long Game is based on the book, Mustang Miracle, written by Humberto G. Garcia.

MercyMe's lead singer, Bart Millard, whose story is told in "I Can Only Imagine" and its sequel, is pictured as an adult with his mother, Adele, and as a child (inset, bottom) in the 1980s. After his mother endured years of emotional abuse, she left Bart's father out of fear for her own life. Bart remained with his father, enduring both physical and emotional abuse. In 2018, Bart made peace with his mother over his difficult childhood. She attended the "I Can Only Imagine" premiere with him and loved the movie, telling him, "I was so scared for my life and I'm so glad that we have each other now." Adele passed away four years later in July 2022. content:
Questioning the Story:

## **Did Bart Millard's mom walk out when he was 13 because of abuse?**

No. The _I Can Only Imagine_ true story reveals that Bart's parents divorced when he was just three years old. According to Bart, his mother always said, "I married a teddy bear but went home with a monster" (_Billboard_). Unlike what is seen in the movie, Bart lived with his mother up until the third grade. It was then that his mother chose to move away with her third husband. It was decided that it would be best for Bart and his older brother Stephen to stay with their father, Arthur (_People_). Bart's brother Stephen (pictured below) is absent from the movie.

![Image 1: Stephen and Brother Bart Millard](https://www.historyvshollywood.com/reelfaces/icanonlyimagine/stphb.jpg)
Bart (right) with his older brother Stephen (left), who is not depicted in the movie.

## **Was Bart Millard's father abusive before his parents split up?**

Yes. Arthur Millard had never laid a hand on Bart's mother, Adele, but she suffered verbal, psychological and emotional abuse. It all started before Bart was born when his father, Arthur, suffered a head injury when he was hit by a diesel truck while working as the guy who waves traffic through construction sites. He didn't break a bone in his body but ended up in a coma for about eight weeks.

"Everybody who knew my dad said that he was the biggest teddy bear," says Bart. "But when he woke up, he had the foulest mouth and the worst temper. It took 12 people to hold him down" _-Catholic Digest_

## **Is the _I Can Only Imagine_ movie based on Bart Millard's memoir?**

No. [Bart Millard's memoir](https://www.historyvshollywood.com/reelfaces/item/i-can-only-imagine-book/) was published a month before the release of the _I Can Only Imagine_ movie. It explores in detail the accurate version of Bart Millard's story, which inspired the movie's version.

## **Was Bart Millard's dad, Arthur, a former football star?**

Yes. He was an All-American football star who played for Southern Methodist University, but he hurt his knee around his sophomore year, which restricted his playing time. "He got homesick, ended up going home, and married my mom," says Bart. He took a job with the Department of Transportation as a flag waver on construction sites. In addition to his head injury from being struck by a truck on the job, the family doctor always felt that getting hit hard playing football since he was five also contributed to the likely frontal lobe injury. _-Catholic Digest_

## **Did Bart's father, Arthur Millard, have substance abuse issues?**

No. His father didn't drink or use drugs. It was his short temper and tendency to take out his frustrations on his son that was at the root of the abuse. "If he got embarrassed or cut off in traffic or whatever, he would take a swing at me," Bart recalls. "I was like his punching bag" (_People_). On occasion, he would beat Bart if the Dallas Cowboys lost. The beatings happened as often as three or four times per week, which left Bart in constant fear (_The Tennessean_).

Bart's dad Arthur in the early 1970s (left) and Dennis Quaid as Arthur Millard in the _I Can Only Imagine_ movie. _Source: Bart Millard Instagram_

## **Did Bart Millard's dad really break a plate over his head?**

Yes. "People ask, 'Did your dad really break a plate over your head?' Sadly, that actually happened," recalls Millard. "And I grabbed a bat and yelled, 'I'm too big to be treated like that! You're crazy!' I said that and left the house." Watching the scene being reenacted on set brought Millard to tears. _-Catholic Digest_

## **Were Bart and his wife Shannon high school sweethearts?**

Yes. "My wife, [Shannon], was my first girlfriend in 8th grade. She's a huge part of my story," Millard wrote on Twitter in January 2017.

Bart and Shannon Millard are pictured at a high school dance in 1990 (left) and several months prior to the movie's 2018 release (right).

## **Did Bart's grandmother really name the band?**

Yes. The _I Can Only Imagine_ true story confirms that Bart's grandmother (Memaw) came up with the name for the band. When he told her he was going to be a singer, she replied, "Mercy me."

## **Does actor J. Michael Finley sing the songs in the movie?**

[](https://www.historyvshollywood.com/reelfaces/item/i-can-only-imagine-soundtrack/)
The I Can Only Imagine Soundtrack features the songs J. Michael Finley sings in the movie.

Yes. J. Michael Finley sings in the movie, which is his big-screen debut. He had previously performed on Broadway, including as Jean Valjean in Les Misérables. You can hear him sing the songs from the movie on the [I Can Only Imagine Soundtrack](https://www.historyvshollywood.com/reelfaces/item/i-can-only-imagine-soundtrack/). Be sure to listen to the song "O Lord, You're Beautiful".

## **Did Bart Millard's father really beat him so badly that he couldn't lay on his back?**

Yes. In the film, Bart Millard (J. Michael Finley) reminds his father (Dennis Quaid) of this childhood incident as his father is trying to make amends. The true story behind _I Can Only Imagine_ reveals that the reason for the beating was because Bart had forged his father's name on a notification that he had made the honor roll. Even though it was a good thing, he didn't want to risk giving his father the letter and sparking a reaction. The school recognized the forgery and called home to let his father know the good news. His father felt embarrassed and waited for Bart to get home.

As soon as Bart walked in, his father began whipping him for several minutes with a razor strap. It was so intense that Bart started to fear that his father was going to kill him. "He beat me all the way through the house," recalled Bart. "Everything on me hurt so badly I couldn't lay on my back." Bart cried in his dark room for hours, until his father burst in and turned on the light. "It's about time you stop crying!" His father froze as he looked at his son's back and saw the black and purplish bruises and the dark welts. It was the first time that Bart had ever heard his father cry.

Fearing he might do something worse to his son, Arthur sent Bart to live with his mother, Adele, and her new husband in San Antonio, Texas. Bart stayed in touch with his dad and quickly realized that he hated living with his mom. He returned to live with his father at the end of the sixth grade. _-The Tennessean_

## **When was Bart's father diagnosed with cancer?**

Arthur Millard was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer at age 44, during Bart's freshman year in high school.

## **Did Bart's dad's cancer diagnosis help to bring them closer together?**

Yes, but it was how much Bart's dad had changed after finding religion that allowed Bart to see him in a new light. "I got a front row seat to see this guy go from being a monster to falling desperately in love with Jesus," Bart says. _-People.com_

Bart Millard with his father Arthur during Bart's senior year of high school. It is the last photo of the two of them together before Arthur died of pancreatic cancer several months later. They are pictured again (inset).

## **Did Bart take care of his father during his father's battle with cancer?**

Yes. Bart acted like a nurse to his father as he went through cancer treatments. After not being very close prior to that, Bart would administer his father's medicine at night and they'd talk for two or three hours until they fell asleep. _-People_

## [](https://www.historyvshollywood.com/reelfaces/item/i-can-only-imagine-movie/)
Bart's dad's religious awakening helped to guide the course of Bart's own life, just like in the movie.

**Did Bart's father's religious awakening change the trajectory of Bart's own life?**

Yes. "It's literally changed the trajectory of my life," Bart said while speaking of his father finding God. Seeing how much it changed his dad helped Bart to discover his own faith. It guided his life, his music, and the choices he's made since. "I guess I grew up thinking that if the Gospel could change that guy, it could change anybody. There was no denying it" (_People_). As emphasized in the movie, Millard says that his dad "went from a monster to the guy I wanted to be like when I grew up" (_CatholicDigest.com_).

## **In real life, Did Bart's mom and dad ever reconcile before his dad died?**

Yes. Though it's not shown in the movie, Bart's mother and father reconciled before his father died. "She was there when he passed away," says Bart. _-Catholic Digest_

## **When did Bart Millard's father pass away in real life?**

"My dad was diagnosed with cancer my freshman year of high school," says Bart. He passed away almost five years later on November 11, 1991, a few months after Bart's graduation. Bart was 19 at the time. "The movie made it look like it all happened in my junior and senior year of high school." _-Catholic Digest_

## **Did Bart Millard's dad really set it up so that Bart would get money each month to pursue his dream of being a singer?**

Yes. Arthur set it up so that when he passed, his son would get $600 a month for 10 years so that he could chase his dreams. Bart received the final check the same week that "[I Can Only Imagine](https://www.historyvshollywood.com/video/mercyme-i-can-only-imagine-music-video/)" reached No. 1 on Christian radio charts. _-The Tennessean_

The real Bart Millard in the mid-2000s (left) and his onscreen counterpart J. Michael Finley (right).

## **How did Bart Millard come up with the idea to write the song "I Can Only Imagine"?**

Like in the movie, the idea for the song came from a comment his grandmother made at his father's funeral. "She said, 'I can only imagine what your dad's seeing now,' and I became obsessed with that phrase," Bart recalled. He spent years constantly writing the phrase down on anything in front of him. "It was more O.C.D. than religious," he admits. When he began work on MercyMe's first album, his notebook was filled with the phrase. He saw it as a sign and started to incorporate it into a song. Having lived the song's backstory, he says it took him only ten minutes to write. Unlike the movie, he didn't write the song right after his father died. Almost seven years had passed before he finally wrote the song in 1998. _-People_

## **Did Amy Grant surprise Bart Millard by asking him to perform the song instead of her?**

The film heightens the drama here a bit. Like in the movie, Bart did give Amy Grant the rights to record the "I Can Only Imagine" song. She knew that it would be a career maker and decided she wanted him to release it. However, she didn't tell Bart by having a sudden change of heart while on stage at a concert. She notified him prior to a scheduled performance at a showcase. She gave the song back to him and asked him if he would perform it with her at the event. _-Contagious Encouragement_

Amy Grant (left) was planning to record the "I Can Only Imagine" song before deciding that Bart (right) should be the one who sings it. _Source: Bart Millard Instagram_

## **When did MercyMe's song "I Can Only Imagine" become a hit?**

Some people who see the movie might not have realized that Bart Millard's song "I Can Only Imagine" became a hit in 2001, 17 years prior to the movie's release. It went on to become the bestselling Christian single of all time.

Watch the Bart Millard Interview & the "I Can Only Imagine" Music Video

Expand on what you know about the true story behind the _I Can Only Imagine_ movie by watching the videos below, including an interview with Bart Millard and the music video for the song.

_**I Can Only Imagine**_ is a 2018 American Christianbiographicaldrama film directed by the Erwin Brothers and written by Alex Cramer, Jon Erwin, and Brent McCorkle, based on the story behind the group MercyMe's song of the same name, one of the best-selling Christian singles of all time.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-5) The film stars J. Michael Finley as Bart Millard, the lead singer who wrote the song about his relationship with his father Arthur Millard (Dennis Quaid). Madeline Carroll, Trace Adkins, Priscilla Shirer, and Cloris Leachman also star.
_I Can Only Imagine_ was released in the United States on March 16, 2018. It was a box office success, grossing $86 million worldwide against a production budget of $7 million, earning more than twelve times its budget. It is the fifth highest-grossing music biopic[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-6) and sixth highest-grossing Christian film[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-7) of all-time in the United States. At the 2018 Dove Awards, the film won "Inspirational Film of the Year".[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Can_Only_Imagine_(film)#cite_note-doveawards.com-8) A sequel, _I Can Only Imagine 2_, was released on February 20, 2026.
Ten-year-old Bart Millard lives with his mother Adele and abusive father Arthur in Texas. One day, Bart's mother drops him off at a Christian camp, where Bart meets Shannon Street. Upon his return from camp, Bart finds that his mother has left and movers are removing her belongings. Bart angrily confronts Arthur, who denies that his abusiveness was the reason she left.

Years later, in high school, Bart and Shannon are dating. Bart plays football to please Arthur, but is injured, breaking both ankles and ending his career. The only elective with openings is music class, so he reluctantly signs up. Initially, Bart is assigned to be a sound technician, but after overhearing him singing, the director casts him in the lead role in the school production of _Oklahoma!_. Bart overcomes his reluctance and gives an impressive performance, but does not tell Arthur, who finds out the night of the show when he happens to see a flyer for the show in a diner. Arthur suddenly collapses in pain, and finds out he has cancer, which he hides from Bart. The following morning, Bart fights with Arthur, who smashes a plate over his head. At church, Shannon sees the blood and presses Bart to open up, but he responds by breaking up with her, and leaves town to seek his fortune in the city.
Bart joins a band in need of a singer, and convinces Christian music producer Scott Brickell to manage the band and secure a showcase in Nashville. Bart surprises Shannon and invites her to tour with the band, and is confused when Shannon flatly refuses. In Nashville, Brickell introduces Bart to established artists Amy Grant and Michael W. Smith, but is unable to convince record executives to sign the band, who do not believe the band, now performing as "MercyMe", is good enough. Devastated, Bart quits the band, but Brickell thinks that Bart needs to resolve issues in his personal life, so Bart reconciles with the band and asks them to wait for him, and leaves to return home.
Bart returns home late at night, and is confused to find that Arthur has prepared breakfast for him the next morning. Arthur claims to have become a Christian, but Bart is skeptical and refuses to forgive him, and leaves. In anger and despair, Arthur smashes his old Jeep, which he had asked Bart to help him restore. Bart attempts to drive away in Arthur's pickup, but discovers his father's terminal cancer diagnosis, and returns to Arthur. Bart forgives his father, and the two form a deep bond, but Arthur soon dies of his illness.

After Arthur's funeral, Bart rejoins the band and writes "I Can Only Imagine", and also calls Shannon and apologizes to her for the first time since their breakup. Brickell sends the demo tape to several artists, including Grant, who, deeply moved by the song, asks to record it herself as her next single, and Bart, who just wants the song to be heard, accepts. On stage, Grant begins the song, but can't bring herself to sing it, and calls Bart on stage from the audience to sing it himself. After Bart's performance, he sees his father in the audience smiling and clapping. The audience gives an enthusiastic ovation, and he reunites with Shannon, who was also in attendance. The band releases the song as their first single, achieving success on both Christian and mainstream radio.
